title: DIRECTOR OF SALES OPERATIONS
description:
U.S. B2B Sales | Independent Sales Representatives | Sales Enablement & CRM



Company: Aprinta

Location: Remote — Philippines, India, or Other International Locations

Employment: Full-Time

Schedule: U.S. Eastern Business Hours

Compensation: $1,800–$2,800 USD Monthly, Based on Experience + Performance Incentives

Reports To: CEO

________________________________________

ABOUT APRINTA



Aprinta is a U.S.-based branded merchandise, promotional products, custom apparel, printing, packaging, and fulfillment company.

We are building a technology-driven platform designed to transform how businesses purchase and manage their branded products.

Our platform combines:

• Personalized Company Stores: Customized e-commerce websites featuring a company's branding, logos, and promotional merchandise.

• Promotional Products & Apparel: Thousands of customizable products for businesses, organizations, and events.

• Printing & Packaging: Commercial printing, marketing materials, branded packaging, and related solutions.

• AI & Automation: Technology that automates website creation, product customization, customer prospecting, and marketing.

• Independent Sales Network: A growing national network of independent sales professionals supported by technology and centralized services.

• Sales & Marketing Technology: Integrated CRM, outbound
, automated calling, and sales management systems.

Our goal is to build one of the most scalable technology-enabled branded merchandise and promotional products businesses in the United States.

We are entering our initial commercial launch and looking for an experienced sales operations professional to help build, manage, and scale our independent sales organization.

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly organized, motivated, and experienced Director of Sales Operations to lead the daily execution of our independent sales representative program.

This is a hands-on leadership position.

You will work directly with our CEO to recruit, onboard, train, support, and manage independent sales representatives throughout the United States.

We currently have approximately 10–15 independent sales representatives preparing to launch, with plans to expand significantly as our business grows.

Our ideal candidate has experience managing remote U.S. B2B sales teams, implementing sales processes, overseeing CRM systems, and driving measurable sales performance.

You must be comfortable communicating directly with American sales professionals, conducting virtual meetings, and managing multiple sales activities simultaneously.

This is not a traditional telemarketing or cold-calling position.

Your primary responsibility is to develop and operate an effective sales organization that helps independent representatives generate revenue.

Initially, you will manage both sales operations and sales coordination. As the organization expands, you will help build and manage a dedicated sales support team.

________________________________________

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Independent Sales Representative Management

Manage the daily operations of Aprinta's growing national independent sales network.

Responsibilities include:

• Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for independent sales representatives.

• Conduct regular individual and group sales meetings.

• Monitor representative activity, sales pipelines, and performance.

• Establish weekly and monthly sales objectives.

• Identify representatives requiring additional training or support.

• Maintain consistent communication with representatives.

• Coordinate sales initiatives, campaigns, and customer opportunities.

• Develop processes to keep representatives engaged and productive.

• Provide regular sales performance reports to executive management.

Primary Objective: Build a highly productive, organized, and accountable independent sales network.

2. Sales Representative Onboarding & Training

Develop and manage a standardized onboarding program.

Responsibilities include:

• Coordinate onboarding for newly recruited representatives.

• Introduce representatives to Aprinta's products, services, and technology.

• Train representatives on personalized company stores and sales presentations.

• Provide training on promotional products, apparel, printing, and packaging.

• Establish CRM access and sales tracking procedures.

• Develop training materials, presentations, and instructional resources.

• Conduct virtual onboarding sessions.

• Ensure representatives understand compensation structures and sales procedures.

Goal: Have new representatives trained, equipped, and actively prospecting within seven days of onboarding.

3. Sales Enablement & Representative Support

Help independent representatives sell more effectively by providing centralized support.

Responsibilities include:

• Coordinate the creation of personalized customer microsites.

• Assist representatives with customer presentations and proposals.

• Coordinate product quotations and pricing requests.

• Manage requests for product samples.

• Coordinate artwork and design assistance.

• Work with purchasing and operations teams on customer opportunities.

• Assist representatives with customer follow-ups.

• Ensure sales requests are completed accurately and promptly.

• Develop sales materials and product presentations.

The objective is to allow representatives to focus on developing customer relationships and generating sales while Aprinta provides centralized administrative and operational support.

4. CRM & Sales Pipeline Management

Own the accuracy and daily management of the sales CRM.

Responsibilities include:

• Maintain accurate representative and customer records.

• Track prospects, opportunities, quotations, and orders.

• Establish standardized sales pipeline stages.

• Monitor follow-up activities and overdue opportunities.

• Maintain sales forecasts and performance dashboards.

• Track customer acquisition and conversion metrics.

• Ensure representatives consistently update CRM records.

• Identify opportunities to improve sales processes through automation.

• Work with the technology team to improve CRM functionality.

Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, GoHighLevel, or similar CRM platforms is preferred.

Aprinta is developing proprietary technology, so candidates must be comfortable learning and implementing new systems.

5. Sales Performance & Reporting

Establish a data-driven sales management process.

Key responsibilities include:

• Track active versus inactive representatives.

• Monitor new customer opportunities.

• Measure quotes generated and orders closed.

• Track sales revenue by representative.

• Monitor pipeline conversion rates.

• Identify sales bottlenecks.

• Prepare weekly sales reports.

• Develop recommendations to improve representative productivity.

• Monitor progress toward sales targets.

You will be expected to identify problems, recommend solutions, and take ownership of execution.

We are looking for someone who understands that sales activity alone does not equal success.

The ultimate measurement is profitable revenue generation.

6. Independent Sales Network Expansion

Support the continued recruitment and growth of Aprinta's sales organization.

Responsibilities include:

• Coordinate with HR on representative recruiting campaigns.

• Review prospective representative applications.

• Schedule interviews and onboarding meetings.

• Help evaluate representative qualifications.

• Maintain recruiting and onboarding pipelines.

• Develop scalable processes for adding representatives.

• Assist with building regional sales teams as the organization grows.

Our long-term objective is to develop a national network of hundreds of independent sales representatives.

The successful candidate will help build the operational infrastructure necessary to support that growth.

7. Cross-Department Coordination

Work closely with Aprinta's internal departments, including:

Technology: Coordinate CRM, microsites, platform access, and sales tools.

Marketing: Coordinate lead generation campaigns, outbound marketing, and prospect assignments.

Purchasing: Obtain product costs, vendor quotations, and sourcing information.

Order Management: Ensure customer orders move efficiently from sales through production and delivery.

Accounting: Coordinate sales reporting, commissions, and payment information.

HR: Support representative recruiting and onboarding.

The Director of Sales Operations will play an important role in connecting these departments and ensuring sales representatives receive timely support.

________________________________________

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Professional Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in B2B sales operations, sales management, or sales enablement.

• At least 2 years managing or supporting U.S.-based sales teams.

• Demonstrated experience managing remote sales professionals.

• Strong understanding of B2B sales pipelines and customer acquisition.

• Experience implementing CRM processes and sales reporting.

• Experience conducting virtual sales meetings and training sessions.

• Strong organizational and project management abilities.

• Experience working directly with U.S. business owners or executives.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Communication Skills

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong presentation and interpersonal skills.

• Confidence leading meetings with experienced American sales representatives.

• Ability to motivate, coach, and hold salespeople accountable.

• Professional communication and problem-solving abilities.

Technology Skills

Candidates should be proficient with:

• CRM software

• Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets

• Zoom or Microsoft Teams

• Sales reporting and dashboards

• Project management tools

• AI productivity and automation tools

Experience working with custom CRM platforms or sales automation systems is a plus.

________________________________________

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will receive additional consideration:

• Promotional products and branded merchandise

• Custom apparel and printing

• B2B e-commerce

• SaaS and technology sales

• Marketing agencies

• Sales outsourcing organizations

• Independent sales representative networks

• Distributor or reseller sales channels

Experience managing commission-based independent sales representatives is especially valuable.

________________________________________

IDEAL CANDIDATE

We are looking for someone who:

Is a builder. You enjoy creating systems, processes, and teams rather than simply maintaining existing operations.

Takes ownership. You identify problems and solve them without waiting for instructions.

Understands salespeople. You know how to motivate, support, and manage independent sales professionals.

Is highly organized. You can manage multiple representatives, opportunities, and requests without losing track of details.

Is comfortable with technology. You understand how CRM systems, automation, and data improve sales performance.

Is results-oriented. You focus on revenue, conversion, productivity, and execution.

Wants to grow. You are interested in helping build a national sales organization and advancing your responsibilities as the company expands.

________________________________________

FIRST 90 DAYS — EXPECTATIONS

First 30 Days: Establish the Foundation

• Complete onboarding and training on Aprinta's platform.

• Meet and onboard the initial 10–15 representatives.

• Establish standardized sales reporting.

• Implement weekly representative meetings.

• Develop a representative support process.

• Establish CRM tracking and performance dashboards.

• Launch a structured representative activation program.

Days 31–60: Improve Sales Productivity

• Establish consistent sales activity across the representative network.

• Identify high-performing representatives.

• Improve sales training and support resources.

• Implement standardized follow-up procedures.

• Coordinate new representative onboarding.

• Identify opportunities to improve sales conversion.

Days 61–90: Prepare for Expansion

• Develop a repeatable sales onboarding and management system.

• Improve representative productivity and sales performance.

• Establish scalable sales support procedures.

• Recommend staffing requirements for future growth.

• Develop a structured plan to expand the independent sales organization.

________________________________________

COMPENSATION & OPPORTUNITY

Base Compensation: $600–$1200 USD per month plus bonus, depending on qualifications and experience.

Performance Incentives: Additional compensation opportunities based on agreed sales performance and operational objectives.

Schedule: Full-time, working U.S. Eastern business hours.

Location: Remote.

Growth Opportunity: Potential to build and lead a larger international sales operations team as Aprinta expands.

This is an opportunity to join a growing U.S. technology-enabled commerce company during its initial commercial launch and help build a national sales organization.

________________________________________

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit:

1. Your resume or professional profile.

2. A brief description of your experience managing U.S. B2B sales teams.

3. The number of sales representatives you have previously managed.

4. The CRM platforms you have used.

5. Your experience managing independent or commission-based sales representatives.

6. Your expected monthly compensation.

7. Your availability to work U.S. Eastern business hours.

REQUIRED APPLICATION QUESTION

Scenario:

Aprinta has 15 independent sales representatives located throughout the United States.

Each representative has access to personalized customer e-commerce stores, promotional products, custom apparel, printing, packaging, and centralized sales support.

You are responsible for getting these representatives actively selling.

Briefly explain how you would organize, manage, and motivate these representatives during your first 30 days.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can provide a specific, practical approach rather than general sales management concepts.

________________________________________

About Aprinta

Aprinta is building a technology-driven platform that makes branded merchandise, promotional products, custom apparel, printing, and packaging easier for businesses to purchase and manage.

Aprinta — Your Brand, Made Easy.

title: Ambassador Program Coordinator (Creator Ops VA)

title: Remote Procurement Agent – Scrap Metal Purchasing (Base Salary + Commission)
description:
Job Type: Full-Time | 100% Remote

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (ET)

Compensation: Base Salary + Performance-Based Commission

Location: Remote – Work from Home



About the Role



We are looking for a motivated, confident, and results-driven Procurement Agent to join our team on a fully remote basis. The successful candidate will be responsible for contacting vendors and suppliers across the United States to purchase scrap metal, developing long-term supplier relationships, negotiating competitive purchase prices, and securing profitable purchasing opportunities.



This position is ideal for someone with a background in sales, telemarketing, business development, or procurement who enjoys speaking with people, negotiating deals, and working toward performance-based targets.



Key Responsibilities



Make outbound calls to scrap metal suppliers, recycling companies, scrap yards, auto salvage yards, battery recyclers, and other relevant vendors throughout the United States.



Identify new suppliers and develop a consistent pipeline of purchasing opportunities.



Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential vendors.



Negotiate competitive purchase prices and purchasing terms.



Follow up with suppliers to secure deals and arrange material purchases.



Qualify vendors based on material type, availability, pricing, quantity, and location.



Maintain accurate records of calls, vendor details, pricing, and follow-up activities in the company's CRM.



Consistently meet monthly purchasing targets and performance expectations.



Coordinate with the internal team to ensure smooth purchasing operations.



Required Qualifications



Minimum 2–3 years of sales experience, preferably in outbound calling, telemarketing, B2B sales, business development, procurement, or vendor management.



College degree is required.



Excellent spoken English with a clear, natural American English accent and strong pronunciation.



Excellent verbal communication, persuasion, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.



Confidence in making outbound calls to businesses across the United States.



Ability to handle objections, follow up consistently, and close purchasing deals.



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.



Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.



Reliable high-speed internet, a computer, a quality headset, and a quiet home workspace.



Willingness to work Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time.



Compensation Structure



This position offers a base salary plus performance-based commission.



Base Salary: A fixed monthly salary, based on the candidate's experience and qualifications.



Commission: Additional earnings based on purchasing performance and results.



Our goal is to reward agents who consistently identify quality suppliers, negotiate competitive prices, and help the company grow its purchasing volume.



Specific compensation details and commission terms will be discussed during the interview.



What We Offer



100% work-from-home opportunity.



Monday-to-Friday schedule.



Fixed base pay plus performance-based earning potential.



Opportunity to develop valuable US B2B sales, negotiation, and procurement skills.



A performance-oriented work environment with opportunities for growth.



Application Requirements – Please Read Carefully



To apply, candidates must complete the following steps:



1. Submit Your Resume



Include your educational qualifications, employment history, and relevant sales or procurement experience.



2. Submit a 30–60 Second Introduction Video



Record a short video of yourself speaking in English with a natural American English accent. In the video, please introduce yourself and briefly explain:



Your educational background.



Your sales experience and previous responsibilities.



Your strongest communication, negotiation, and sales skills.



Why you believe you would be successful in this remote procurement role.



Please speak naturally and confidently. We are interested in evaluating your spoken English, clarity, confidence, communication skills, and ability to present yourself professionally.



3. Confirm Your Availability



Please confirm that you can work Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time, including the corresponding local working hours and any daylight-saving time changes.



Important: Applications without the required introduction video may not be considered.



How to Apply



Submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph with your resume and introduction video. Please ensure that your video link is accessible.



We are looking for someone who is confident on the phone, commercially minded, persistent with follow-ups, and motivated to earn additional income through performance-based commissions.



If you have the right sales skills, a strong work ethic, and the drive to build supplier relationships across the United States, we encourage you to apply.

You will own the full recruiting cycle, from sourcing and screening through client-specific onboarding and placement.

Each client has its own requirements, settings, and onboarding process, so you will need to track them carefully. You will work closely with Scheduling, Clinical Coordination, and HR to fill open shifts and contracts quickly and keep every clinician compliant. Prior recruiting experience in healthcare or medical staffing is required, and contingent staffing experience is preferred.



Key responsibilities

title: Virtual Administrative & Auction Assistant
description:
Caring Transitions of Parsippany is a growing, family-owned business in New Jersey, USA. We help individuals and families navigate life's transitions through downsizing, senior relocations, estate sales, and online auctions.



We're a small, collaborative team that believes there is almost always a better, smarter, or more creative way to get things done. We value fresh perspectives, new technology, and people who are willing to share their ideas.



We're looking for a full-time Virtual Administrative & Auction Assistant who wants to become a valued part of our team—not simply someone who completes a list of assigned tasks.



You'll work closely with our owners and Director of Growth & Business Development, helping us manage our online auctions, marketing activities, and day-to-day business operations.



We want someone who takes pride in doing great work, enjoys learning, notices opportunities for improvement, and isn't afraid to say, "I have an idea!"



What You'll Be Doing



Online Auctions & Listings



Research products and prepare accurate, engaging descriptions using ChatGPT and other resources.



Prepare, organize, and quality-check auction listings on CTBids.



Check photographs, measurements, condition details, and descriptions for accuracy.



Monitor auction activity and help identify items that would benefit from additional promotion.



Help organize auction documentation, reports, and pickup preparation.



Assist with bidder inquiries and auction follow-up.



Marketing & Creative Support



Help develop engaging social media content and auction promotions.



Use ChatGPT to brainstorm marketing ideas, research audiences, and improve content.



Create and edit short promotional videos using CapCut.



Create basic graphics using Canva or similar tools.



Research relevant
 groups and other opportunities to reach potential bidders.



Schedule and publish approved social media posts.



Bring new ideas for reaching customers and promoting our services.



Administrative & Project Support



Maintain accurate customer and project records in Jobber and other CRM systems.



Update spreadsheets, task lists, schedules, and project documentation.



Help track follow-ups, deadlines, and upcoming activities.



Monitor supply needs and assist with ordering packing materials and other supplies.



Organize digital files, customer information, and internal records.



Help identify opportunities to streamline repetitive processes.



What We're Looking For



Required Qualifications



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.



Experience using ChatGPT or similar AI tools for writing, research, and productivity.



Proficiency with Google Sheets, Google Docs, and common business software.



Reliable, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently.



Strong communication skills and a willingness to ask questions.



A genuine interest in learning and improving how work gets done.



Preferred Experience



Jobber or similar project management software.



CRM systems and customer record management.



E-commerce, online auctions, or product listings.



CapCut, Canva, and social media content creation.



Social media scheduling and digital marketing.



QuickBooks familiarity (bookkeeping is not required).



Previous experience supporting a U.S.-based business.



The Kind of Teammate Who Will Thrive Here



You'll enjoy this role if you:



Like finding better ways to organize work and improve processes.



Are comfortable sharing ideas and suggestions, even when they're different from how we've done things before.



Enjoy using technology and AI to make work more efficient.



Take ownership of assignments and follow through without constant reminders.



Care about accuracy and recognize when something needs a second look.



Enjoy collaborating with others, even when working remotely.



Want to grow your skills and take on additional responsibilities over time.



We're happy to teach you our systems. What matters most is your attitude, curiosity, reliability, and willingness to contribute.



Schedule & Compensation



Full-time, 40 hours per week.



Starting compensation: $5 USD per hour.



Remote position based in the Philippines.



Flexible hybrid schedule with some required overlap with U.S. Eastern Time for team meetings, collaboration, and communication.



Target start date: November–December 2026.



Long-term opportunity with the potential to grow alongside our business.



Why Join Us?



We're a small business where your contributions will be noticed and appreciated.



We believe that great ideas can come from anyone on the team. We encourage questions, creativity, collaboration, and suggestions for improving our work.



You'll have the opportunity to learn about online auctions, digital marketing, project management, and the operations of a growing U.S. business.



We're looking for someone who wants to work with us, not just for us.



How to Apply



Please send:



A brief introduction and description of your relevant experience.



Examples of administrative, e-commerce, or social media work you've completed.



A description of how you've used ChatGPT or other AI tools in your previous work.



Your preferred working hours and availability for some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



Your earliest available start date.

title: Purchasing Specialist – Pokémon TCG (Remote)
description:
About us



We are a German trading group that imports and distributes Pokémon TCG products in Japanese, Korean, Chinese and English – plus One Piece and Dragon Ball.



We are a small, fast-moving, owner-led team working fully remote across Europe and Asia. Decisions are made in hours, not weeks – and purchasing is the engine of the whole business.





The role



You will be our Purchasing Specialist for Pokémon TCG, working directly with the owner and the sales team. Your job is simple to describe and hard to do well: get the right sealed product, at the best landed price, from reliable suppliers, in time for our customers' orders.



We buy almost exclusively against confirmed customer orders. That means you need to be fast, precise and commercially sharp: a few percent on the purchase price or a missed delivery window makes the difference between a good and a bad month.



This is a hands-on operational role, not a strategy position. You will be in supplier chats, price lists and spreadsheets every day.





Your responsibilities



- Sourcing: find and qualify new suppliers for sealed Pokémon product (English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese) – distributors, sub-distributors, wholesalers, brokers and exporters in North America and Asia.

- Price comparison: collect and compare supplier offers daily, maintain our purchasing sheets (Google Sheets / Excel) and always know who is cheapest for which SKU right now.

- Landed-cost calculation: calculate the full cost per unit – purchase price, currency conversion (USD, CAD, JPY, KRW), freight per kg, customs duty, labelling – so sales can quote correctly.

- Negotiation: negotiate prices, discounts, payment terms and minimum order quantities with suppliers, mostly via WhatsApp,
 and supplier portals.

- Order placement: turn confirmed customer demand into supplier orders, check availability, place and track orders, and chase late or partial deliveries.

- Inbound coordination: create shipping labels and inbound notifications, convert case quantities into units, and confirm that the warehouse booked in what was ordered.

- Market awareness: follow release calendars, allocations, price movements and reprints (TCGplayer, retailer announcements) and flag opportunities and risks early.

- Data hygiene: keep product data – names, barcodes, units per case, boosters per box – correct and verified across our systems.





What you bring



Must-haves



- Real knowledge of the Pokémon TCG sealed market: you know the difference between a booster box, a display, an ETB and a bundle, you know what Prismatic Evolutions or 151 are, and you understand why one set sells and another does not.

- 2+ years of experience in purchasing, trading, sourcing or e-commerce operations – ideally in TCG, collectibles, toys or FMCG.

- Strong spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets / Excel): lookups, currency conversion, margin and landed-cost calculations are daily tools for you, not a challenge.

- Fluent written and spoken English; you are comfortable negotiating with suppliers in the USA, Canada and Asia via chat and
.

- A trader's mindset: numbers-driven, fast, persistent, and not afraid to ask for a better price.

- Reliability and precision: an order with a wrong quantity or a mixed-up SKU costs real money, and you are the person who catches it.

- Availability to work with overlapping time zones (North America and Asia) when needed.



Nice-to-haves



- Experience with import logistics (freight per kg, customs, EORI).





What we offer



- 100 % remote – work from wherever you are; our team is spread across Europe and Asia.

- Direct line to the owner – no layers, no committees; you get decisions and budgets fast.

- Real responsibility from day one – you manage large purchase volumes every month and see the impact of your work immediately.

- A growing business in a market you love – we are expanding across Europe, and purchasing grows with it.

- European working hours.

- Competitive compensation based on experience, with a performance component tied to purchasing results.





Application task (required)



We only read applications that include this task. It takes about 30 minutes and shows us how you work.



Part 1 – Landed-cost calculation



The following example is fictional. A US supplier offers you these products, prices in USD per unit, ex warehouse (no shipping included):



- Product A: Elite Trainer Box – 10 units per case – 95 USD per unit – 18 lbs per case

- Product B: Booster Bundle – 24 units per case – 42 USD per unit – 20 lbs per case

- Product C: Booster Box – 6 units per case – 160 USD per unit – 14 lbs per case



Assumptions: shipping to Europe costs 1.20 € per lb, customs duty is 4 % on goods plus freight, exchange rate 1 € = 1.10 USD. We sell at landed cost × 1.15.



For each product, give us the landed cost per unit in EUR and the resulting selling price per unit in EUR. Show your calculation in a Google Sheet or Excel file and attach it.



Part 2 – Three short questions (two to four sentences each)



1. A customer has ordered 300 Booster Bundles of a set for delivery in four weeks. Describe how you would source them – where you would look, how you would compare offers and what could go wrong.

2. Name three current or upcoming English Pokémon TCG sets you would buy in volume right now, and one you would avoid. Why?

3. A supplier confirms a price on Monday and raises it by 8 % on Wednesday when you want to order. What do you do?





How to apply



Send us a short
 with your CV, your completed application task (spreadsheet plus answers) and three to five sentences on your experience with Pokémon TCG and purchasing – no cover letter needed. Applications without the task will not be considered. If you have ever bought sealed product in volume, tell us which sets, from where, and at what kind of margin.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video call with the owner. We reply to every application within one week.

Ignite AI is a UK training company delivering government-funded AI upskilling programmes for business owners. We run multiple cohort-based programmes at once, with a small senior team and a pool of expert facilitators. We are growing fast, with new government contracts just signed, and we need the person who holds it all together.



The role



You are the operational backbone of the delivery team. The founder and Head of Delivery are big-picture people. Your job is to be the opposite: the organised, detail-driven person who makes sure every schedule is set, every tracker is up to date, every participant is chased, and nothing is ever forgotten.



What you'll do



 • Keep the master programme trackers accurate and current (cohorts, sessions, attendance, participant progress)

 • Schedule sessions, book calls, send invites, confirm facilitators, and manage the delivery calendar

 • Run participant admin: onboarding packs, registration, reminders, follow-ups and chasing non-responders

 • Prepare the weekly delivery report so the senior team always knows exact status

 • Own the agendas and action logs for team meetings, and chase actions to completion

 • Keep our systems tidy: files named and filed, records complete, data entered properly

 • Support participant recruitment admin during cohort intake periods

 • Help manage our online community spaces



Who you are



 • At least 3 years in operations coordination, executive assistance, project administration or similar

 • Fiercely organised. You love checklists, trackers and finishing things, and untidy systems genuinely bother you

 • Reliable to the minute: deadlines kept, messages answered, same quality every week

 • Excellent written and spoken English, with a friendly, professional tone for participant
s

 • Confident with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, and comfortable learning new tools quickly (we use Notion and AI tools daily; experience with ChatGPT or Claude is a plus, not a requirement)

 • Able to work hours that overlap with the UK morning and early afternoon

 • Looking for a long-term home, not a stopgap



Pay and setup



 • Competitive monthly salary (we pay at the upper end of the market for the right person), paid reliably every month

 • 20 hours per week to start, with real scope to grow to full time as our contracts grow

 • 13th month pay honoured

 • Paid onboarding and training period, working directly with the founder



How to apply



Reply with "ORGANISED" as the first word of your application so we know you read this fully. Then tell us, in no more than 200 words: the system or tracker you're proudest of building or maintaining, and what your current or last manager would say is the thing they never had to worry about with you around. Attach your CV.

title: Editorial / Publication Designer
description:
Type: Freelance / Project-Based (Adobe InDesign + Print)

Project Period: November 2026–March 2027

Estimated Time: Approximately 80–100 hours total, with workload varying throughout the project

Rate: $10–12 USD/hour, depending on experience and portfolio

Location: Remote / Philippines

Potential: Recurring publication work for the right designer





ABOUT THE PROJECT



Good Done Daily is a small graphic design practice based in Detroit, Michigan (USA). We work primarily with nonprofit, civic, philanthropic, and community-based organizations.



I am looking for an experienced editorial and publication designer to collaborate with me on the redesign of a semiannual print magazine for a U.S.-based nonprofit organization.



The publication is approximately 16 pages, full color, professionally printed, and mailed to a large audience.



The project includes two connected parts:



1. Develop a stronger, reusable editorial design system.

2. Apply that system to the first redesigned issue and prepare it for professional printing.



This is not primarily a social media or general marketing-design role. I am specifically looking for someone with substantial experience designing magazines, publications, books, annual reports, or other multi-page print work.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You should have:



• 8+ years of professional graphic design experience

• Strong experience with editorial, magazine, publication, or long-form print design

• Advanced to expert knowledge of Adobe InDesign

• Strong Adobe Photoshop skills for retouching, color correction, masking, compositing, and image preparation

• Strong typography, composition, hierarchy, pacing, and layout skills

• A systems-oriented approach to design

• Professional experience preparing files for commercial print production

• A portfolio showing substantial multi-page editorial work



Working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator is also expected.





INDESIGN + PRINT PRODUCTION



You should be highly comfortable with:



• Parent/master pages

• Paragraph, character, and object styles

• Baseline grids and layout grids

• Multi-column text flow and long-form documents

• Linked assets and organized file structures

• Templates and reusable publication systems

• CMYK and color-management principles

• Bleeds, trim, margins, image resolution, and print specifications

• Preflight and error checking

• Print-ready PDF export and file packaging



Professional print-production knowledge is required. You should understand how to prepare technically correct files for a commercial printer, not only how to create attractive layouts.





WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON



Editorial design system



• Develop one primary visual direction

• Establish grids, page structures, typography, hierarchy, and recurring elements

• Design representative covers, features, articles, contents pages, short-form sections, and back-of-book layouts

• Develop treatments for photography, captions, pull quotes, credits, and supporting graphics

• Build a flexible InDesign system that can be reused across future issues



First redesigned issue



• Apply the approved system to an approximately 16-page magazine

• Lay out articles and recurring sections

• Retouch, crop, and prepare supplied photography

• Adapt layouts to different story lengths and image availability

• Refine pages through review and feedback

• Preflight, package, and prepare final files for commercial printing



AI-generated photography or illustration will not be used as final publication artwork.





HOW WE WILL WORK TOGETHER



I will provide overall creative direction, client communication, design critique, and project oversight.



I am looking for someone who can take that direction and work independently at a high level—someone who can help develop the system and then execute it carefully in layout and production.



You should:



• Think in systems rather than designing every page from scratch

• Have excellent attention to typography and production details

• Keep InDesign files and linked assets organized

• Communicate clearly and ask questions when needed

• Respond well to direct design feedback

• Meet agreed deadlines

• Identify design or production problems before they become larger issues



The project will include both lighter planning periods and more concentrated design and production phases. You should be comfortable working efficiently during active periods, managing deadlines, and maintaining strong attention to detail under normal production pressure.



Occasional scheduled overlap with U.S. Eastern Time will be needed for design reviews and will be arranged in advance. I’m happy to be reasonably flexible around timing and, when possible, schedule meetings at hours that work comfortably for both of us rather than always requiring late-evening availability in the Philippines.



The estimated 80–100 hours will be distributed across the full project period. Workload will vary by phase, with lighter weeks and more concentrated design and production periods. Applicants should generally have capacity for up to 15 hours per week when the project is most active.



For the right designer, there may be opportunities to continue working on future spring and fall issues and other Good Done Daily publication projects.





HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A link to your portfolio.

2. Two or three examples of magazine, publication, book, annual report, or other multi-page print work that you personally designed.

3. A short description of your role on those projects.

4. Your years of professional design experience.

5. A brief description of your Adobe InDesign and commercial print-production experience.

6. Your current hourly rate.

7. Your availability from November 2026 through March 2027.



Please do not submit only social media graphics, logos, branding mockups, or advertising work. I need to see actual multi-page editorial design.



Individual applicants only, please. I am looking to work directly with the designer who will be completing the work, not an agency or subcontracted team.



Begin your application with the words “SYSTEMS FIRST” so I know you have read the full posting.



There is no unpaid design test required for the initial application. Selected finalists may be invited to a short conversation and, if needed, a small paid design exercise.

compliance work, including tax returns (corporate and/or partnership), extensions,

This is an ideal opportunity for a tax professional looking to further develop their U.S.

income tax returns accurately and within required deadlines.

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Facebook and Instagram Ads (CapCut, Remote, Long-Term, $5/hr CAD)
description:
PAY

$5 CAD per hour to start, raised to $6 CAD per hour after a 60-day review. At 25 to 35 hours a week that is roughly $540 to $760 CAD per month. Paid every two weeks by bank transfer to your Wise account or local bank.



HOURS

25 to 35 hours a week to start, with more hours as we add clients. Your schedule is flexible, but we need at least 3 hours of overlap with Eastern Time (Toronto) on working days for communication. For example, being online from 8 PM to 11 PM Manila time covers this.



ABOUT US

Acquirely is a Canadian Meta ads agency that helps local service businesses get more booked jobs from
 and Instagram. We work with real owners (painters, renovators, dog trainers and other local companies) who film short videos on their phones, and our job is to turn that footage into ads that make people stop scrolling and ask about the service. We are a small, fast-moving team, and the editor we hire will be one of the most important people in the business, because the video is what sells.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit 9:16 vertical ads, usually 45 to 80 seconds long, from raw phone footage our clients upload to Google Drive.

- Edit about 20 to 35 videos a week across our clients, with each video turned around within 2 business days of the footage arriving, ideally sooner.

- Follow our written Editing Standards and Format Guides, which cover six ad formats (walk-and-talk transformations, selfie-style talking videos, job timelapses, customer testimonials, listed tips, and speed ramps). Consistent quality matters more to us than anything else.

- Build a strong first 3 seconds every time, with a text hook, a visual hook and an audio hook. Never open on a logo, filler, or a sentence that starts in the middle.

- Cut every "um", restart, repeat and pause, and match b-roll to exactly what the speaker is saying.

- Add clean captions with perfect spelling, balanced audio (voice first, then music, then sound effects), and only the effects that have a reason to be there.

- Build a reusable CapCut template for each format so a normal edit gets faster without losing quality.

- Upload finished videos to our review folder, apply feedback quickly, and flag missing or unusable footage in Slack the same day you find it.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 1 year editing short-form content for TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts or ads.

- Strong CapCut skills (this is our main tool). Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve or After Effects experience is a bonus.

- A portfolio with at least 3 vertical videos you edited yourself, ideally ads or talking-head content.

- Good written and spoken English, because scripts, captions, feedback and meetings are all in English.

- A reliable computer, stable internet, and a backup plan for power outages.

- You care about details, you hit deadlines, and you tell us early when something is going wrong. Communication and reliability are what we value most.



NICE TO HAVE

- You have edited ads for a business before and understand that an ad has to sell, not just look good.

- You can design simple static image ads in Canva.

- You have worked with a US or Canadian team before.



WHAT YOU GET

- Steady, long-term work with a growing agency, with more volume as we add clients.

- A raise to $6 CAD/hr after 60 days, with more growth for strong editors as the team expands.

- Clear written standards, example videos and direct feedback, so you always know what good looks like.

- One point of contact, fast answers, and no micromanaging once you have shown you can deliver.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the items below.

2. Shortlisted editors get a short paid test edit. We send raw footage and a script, you send back a finished ad.

3. A short video call with the founders.

4. Start, with a 60-day review and raise.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "ACQ" so we know you read the whole post. Applications without it will not be opened.



In your application, include:

1. Google Drive links to 3 vertical videos you edited, with one sentence on what you did in each.

2. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the $5 CAD/hr starting rate, and how many hours a week you can work.

3. Your timezone, the hours you are usually online, and confirmation that you can cover at least 3 Eastern Time hours on working days.

4. Your answer to this question: "What should happen in the first 3 seconds of a
 ad, and why?"



Keep it short. We read every application that follows these steps.

title: CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATOR
description:

6. Your expected monthly salary

7. Confirmation of availability for EST hours

title: Senior Accountant
description:
PLEASE READ THE QUALIFICATIONS CAREFULLY.

A RESUME IS REQUIRED TO BE CONSIDERED. MESSAGES WITHOUT A RESUME WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.

MUST BE AVAILABLE TO WORK U.S. PACIFIC STANDARD TIME (PST) HOURS.

THE CONTRACT WILL BE MANAGED THROUGH DEEL, AND WORK WILL BE TRACKED USING HUBSTAFF.

INTERNATIONAL TEAM MEMBERS ARE ELIGIBLE FOR 17 DAYS OF PAID TIME OFF (PTO).



ABOUT BOOSTED COMMERCE



Boosted Commerce (founded in 2019) is a digitally-native, CPG platform focused on acquiring and building new, fast-growing beauty, health, and wellness brands. We are a seasoned team of traditional retail and ecommerce operators already scaling several consumer brands with proven product-market fit.



As we expand our operations, we are looking for a highly motivated Senior Accountant to join our accounting team and help us build robust, scalable accounting practices that support our continued growth.



Position Summary



The Senior Accountant will play a key role in managing weekly and month-end accounting operations related to sales audit, payment reconciliation, cash applications, multi-currency transactions, inventory management, and sales tax. This position requires strong experience working with eCommerce platforms and high transaction volumes, along with excellent problem-solving, process improvement, analytical, and organizational skills.



You will work closely with the Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer Service teams to ensure financial accuracy, timely reporting, and operational efficiency.



Key Responsibilities

Perform and support the monthly close process for Revenue, Cash, AR, Inventory & COGS, and Prepaid accounts.

Prepare and maintain supporting documentation, reconciliations, and internal controls to ensure accuracy and support audit and compliance requirements.

Audit and reconcile sales transactions across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, and other eCommerce platforms. Investigate and resolve variances, missing transactions, and sales invoices.

Reconcile cash receipts and AR balances across multiple payment platforms, including Amazon, Shopify, Payoneer, PayPal, Stripe, and other payment providers, as well as the accounting ERP system.

Investigate and resolve GL discrepancies and reconciling items in a timely manner.

Support inventory accounting and reconciliations, including inventory adjustments, inventory in transit, and prepaid inventory.

Partner with the Supply Chain team to investigate and resolve inventory and COGS variances.

Prepare and support monthly reporting and analysis related to Amazon operating expenses, Shopify sales tax, and other financial activities.

Support various ad hoc accounting and financial analysis projects as needed.

Identify opportunities to improve and streamline billing, reconciliation, reporting, and accounting processes.

Recommend and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.



Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

5+ years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in an eCommerce, DTC, consumer goods, or high-volume transaction environment.

Strong understanding of GAAP and the month-end close process.

Demonstrated experience preparing balance sheet reconciliations, supporting schedules, and financial analyses, including resolving complex reconciling items.

CPA or CPA candidate preferred.

Strong hands-on experience reconciling multi-channel sales and payment gateways and analyzing detailed transaction reports from platforms such as Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, and TikTok Shop.

Strong experience with ERP systems, with NetSuite highly preferred.

Experience supporting or participating in accounting system implementations, process improvements, or other operational projects.

Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced remote environment.

Excellent communication skills and strong attention to detail.

title: Hiring: IT Specialist – Advanced Networking, VPN & Web Access Troubleshooting
description:
Project Type: Fixed-Price Freelance Project

Project Budget: $500 USD

Payment Terms: Payment upon successful resolution and verification

Potential Opportunity: Full-Time Position Upon Successful Completion



Project Overview



We are looking for a highly technical, resourceful, and experienced IT specialist to diagnose and resolve a complex web application access issue.



The ideal candidate must have strong expertise in networking, server infrastructure, VPN technologies, IP address analysis, Linux administration, and remote-access configurations. We need someone who can independently investigate the root cause, develop a reliable and secure solution, and demonstrate that the issue has been successfully resolved.



This is a results-oriented freelance project intended for someone with genuine technical expertise and strong problem-solving skills.



Key Responsibilities



Diagnose the root cause of geographic, IP-based, and network-related access restrictions.



Investigate public IP address classification, DNS resolution, routing, connectivity, and network configurations.



Evaluate VPN configurations, VPS infrastructure, remote desktop solutions, and other relevant technologies.



Determine whether hosting-provider IP ranges, server locations, network policies, or browser configurations contribute to the issue.



Identify the most effective, stable, and secure technical solution.



Implement and test the agreed solution in an authorized environment.



Verify successful access using an approved testing method.



Provide a concise technical handover covering the root cause, implemented solution, configuration, limitations, and ongoing maintenance requirements.



Required Technical Expertise



Applicants should have demonstrable experience in the following areas:



Advanced networking and TCP/IP troubleshooting.



VPN technologies, routing, DNS, and public IP reputation or classification analysis.



Linux server administration, particularly Ubuntu.



VPS deployment, configuration, and remote-access infrastructure.



Browser diagnostics and web application troubleshooting.



Network security, firewall rules, access-control policies, and diagnostic tools.



Cloud infrastructure and remote desktop environments.



Root-cause analysis for complex connectivity and access issues.



Experience troubleshooting legitimate geographic access restrictions and distinguishing between infrastructure-related issues and application-level access policies is a strong advantage.



Project Deliverables



The successful freelancer must provide:



Root Cause Analysis: A clear explanation of why the access issue is occurring, supported by technical findings.



Implemented Solution: A reliable, secure, and technically sound solution that complies with the platform's applicable access policies.



Successful Verification: A demonstration that the issue has been resolved using an authorized test account or approved testing method.



Technical Documentation: A brief handover documenting the configuration, troubleshooting steps, and implemented changes.



Maintenance Recommendations: An explanation of any limitations, recurring infrastructure costs, subscription requirements, or future maintenance needs.



Completion will be assessed against these agreed deliverables, rather than simply the completion of troubleshooting attempts or the provision of recommendations.



Compensation and Payment Terms



Fixed Project Fee: $500 USD



Payment will be released only after:



The underlying issue has been successfully resolved.

The solution has been demonstrated and verified against the agreed acceptance criteria.

All required deliverables and technical documentation have been provided.

Any additional hosting, software, VPS, or subscription expenses must be discussed and approved in advance. These costs are separate from the project fee and must not be incurred without prior authorization.

Applicants must be comfortable working under a results-based arrangement with clearly defined completion criteria.



Potential Full-Time Opportunity



This project may serve as an initial engagement to evaluate the freelancer's technical proficiency, analytical thinking, reliability, communication, and ability to solve complex IT problems independently.

A successful candidate may be offered an opportunity to join our company in a full-time IT position, depending on project performance, business requirements, and mutual agreement.



We are interested in building a long-term working relationship with someone who can contribute to our technical operations beyond this initial assignment.



How to Apply



Please include the following information in your proposal:



Technical Background: Briefly describe your relevant experience in networking, VPNs, VPS infrastructure, Linux administration, and web application troubleshooting.



Relevant Projects: Provide examples of similar technical issues you have diagnosed and resolved. Explain your role and the outcome.



Diagnostic Approach: Outline how you would investigate this issue, identify the root cause, and determine the most appropriate solution.



Estimated Timeline: Indicate how long you expect the initial diagnosis and implementation to take.



Acceptance of Terms: Confirm that you accept the fixed $500 USD project fee, payable upon successful completion and verification of the agreed deliverables.



Please do not include confidential client information in your examples. Redacted technical reports or other evidence of previous work are welcome.



Final Note



We are looking for someone who is genuinely technically proficient, resourceful, analytical, discreet, and capable of working independently.



The successful candidate should be able to move beyond basic troubleshooting, identify the actual cause of the problem, and deliver a solution that is reliable, secure, maintainable, and compliant with the platform's access policies.



If you have the technical expertise and confidence to take on this challenge, we welcome your proposal.

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Growing Jewelry & Luxury Watch Brand — Long-Term Position
description:
I’m the owner of a growing jewelry and luxury watch business, and I’m looking for a talented, reliable, and motivated short-form video editor to join my team for the long term.



My content revolves around luxury watches, jewelry, real-world negotiations, entertaining interactions, business deals, and behind-the-scenes footage. The goal is to build a recognizable personal brand across Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



I’m not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together. I’m looking for someone who understands how to capture attention, keep viewers watching, create engaging content, and help a brand grow.



My goal is to find someone I can build a long-term working relationship with, not someone I have to constantly chase, supervise, or replace.



Responsibilities



• Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

• Create engaging edits with strong hooks, clean cuts, well-timed captions, sound effects, zooms, transitions, and pacing.

• Understand how to maintain viewer attention and eliminate unnecessary pauses or boring sections.

• Follow the style and direction of my brand while bringing your own creative ideas to the table.

• Deliver consistent, high-quality work on agreed-upon deadlines.

• Communicate clearly about progress, questions, revisions, and any potential delays.

• Stay organized with project files, footage, revisions, and completed videos.

• Learn my preferences over time so the editing process becomes faster, smoother, and more efficient.

• Be proactive about suggesting improvements to the content rather than waiting for instructions on every little detail.



Experience editing luxury watches, jewelry, negotiations, interviews, podcasts, or personal-brand content is a plus, but strong editing skills and the right attitude matter most.



Requirements — Please Read Carefully



I’m looking for someone who takes their work seriously and can be counted on consistently.



1. Reliable computer and equipment



You must have a capable, relatively modern computer or laptop that can comfortably handle short-form video editing. You should be able to edit footage smoothly without constant freezing, crashing, or excessive rendering delays.



Please disclose your computer’s specifications, including processor, RAM, storage, and graphics capabilities if applicable.



A modern smartphone is also preferred for reviewing content, communicating, and checking how videos look on mobile platforms.



2. Reliable electricity and internet



You must have a dependable electricity supply and stable internet connection that allow you to work consistently.



Because this is a long-term position with deadlines, I need someone who has a realistic plan for handling occasional power interruptions or internet outages. A backup power source, such as a UPS or power station, and backup internet through mobile data or another provider are strong advantages.



Occasional outages can happen anywhere. What matters is that you have the infrastructure, preparation, and communication skills to minimize disruptions and meet commitments.



3. Excellent English communication



You must be comfortable communicating in English, both in writing and in conversation when needed.



You should understand instructions, ask questions when something is unclear, explain challenges professionally, and communicate without me having to repeatedly follow up.



4. Consistency and accountability



I need someone dependable who shows up, meets deadlines, responds to messages within a reasonable timeframe during agreed working hours, and takes ownership of their responsibilities.



If you encounter a problem, communicate early rather than disappearing or waiting until a deadline has passed.



5. A strong work ethic



I’m looking for someone motivated to improve, learn my style, and grow alongside the business. I value initiative, honesty, attention to detail, and a willingness to put in consistent effort.



I don’t expect perfection on day one.

I also like people with good music taste :)

title: Tax Operations Associate
description:
DiLucci CPA Firm - Tax Operations Associate



Compensation: $6/hour (USD)

Schedule: Full-Time: 40+ hours per week (9am - 6pm US CST)

During tax season, additional hours and weekend availability will be required as needed to meet client and firm deadlines.

Location: Remote - Philippines



Role Overview

If you enjoy creating efficient systems, keeping projects moving, and ensuring every tax engagement is delivered accurately and on time, our Tax Operations Associate role is for you.



We want to be very transparent - we are the place people go to grow, not to relax. We work more, we work on harder returns, and we enjoy it. If you're not ready to work evenings and weekends during tax season, and to also focus on quality/learning throughout the year, you will hate it here.



DiLucci CPA Firm has been serving business owners and real estate investors since 2005. For nearly two decades, we've built a reputation for doing tax differently—by going deeper than compliance, telling clients the truth, and using the tax code strategically to protect and grow their wealth. Our mission is simple: help clients keep more of what they earn while giving them clarity, confidence, and a long-term plan. We value enjoying what we do (what we call Fun Tax Energy), moving with speed, and operating independently with a focus on the outcome.



As our Tax Operations Associate, you will support the day-to-day operations of the tax team by staying client focused on follow up regarding tax and accounting open items. You'll play a key role in creating operational excellence while allowing our tax professionals to focus on delivering exceptional client service.



This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented role for someone who enjoys ownership, problem-solving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Key Responsibilities

1. Open Items Follow Up

- Review open-item requests prepared by the tax or accounting team.

- Confirm that requested documents or information are actually missing before contacting the client.

- Contact clients regarding outstanding documents, unanswered questions, signatures, approvals, and other required action items.

- Follow up consistently until each item is resolved.

- Track every request, response, follow-up date, and current status in the firm’s systems.

- Escalate unresponsive clients or time-sensitive issues before they affect deadlines.

- Avoid requesting documents or information that the client has already provided.

2. Client Communication

- Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding outstanding items.

- Clearly explain what is needed, why it is needed, and when it is due.

- Send concise, professional, and easy-to-understand follow-up messages.

- Respond promptly to client questions related to document requests and next steps.

- Maintain a helpful but persistent approach when multiple follow-ups are required.

- Ensure clients always understand their remaining responsibilities.

3. Document Review and Organization

- Review submitted documents to confirm that the requested item was received.

- Identify incomplete, unreadable, incorrect, or missing documents.

- Upload, categorize, and organize files in the appropriate client folder or system.

- Update open-item lists immediately when documents or responses are received.

- Confirm that resolved items are properly closed before work is returned to the tax or accounting team.

4. Internal Coordination

- Communicate with tax preparers, reviewers, bookkeepers, and other team members regarding unresolved items.

- Ask internal team members for clarification when a request is unclear or appears duplicative.

- Provide clear status updates on clients with outstanding items.

- Notify the appropriate team member when all requested information has been received.

- Escalate technical tax or accounting questions rather than attempting to answer them independently.

5. Deadline Management

- Monitor due dates associated with open requests.

- Prioritize follow-ups based on filing deadlines, internal deadlines, and engagement urgency.

- Follow up before outstanding items become urgent.

- Maintain accurate tracking so the team has visibility into delayed or unresponsive clients.

- Ensure no engagement is delayed without documented follow-up and escalation.



Role Expectations

- Open-item requests are accurate and do not duplicate information already provided.

- Clients receive timely, clear, and professional follow-up.

- Outstanding items are followed through to completion rather than simply requested once.

- Client responses and documents are accurately tracked and organized.

- Unresponsive clients are escalated early.

- The tax and accounting teams can quickly see what is missing and what has been received.

- No engagement falls behind because an open item was forgotten or not followed up on.



Requirements

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Accounting, Tax, Bookkeeping, Finance, or a related field

- Required: Previous experience supporting U.S. tax preparation or tax operations in a CPA firm or tax practice

- Strong understanding of the U.S. tax return preparation process for both individual and business tax engagements

- Familiarity with the following U.S. tax forms is strongly preferred:

1. Individual Tax Forms

Form 1040 – U.S. Individual Income Tax Return

Schedule A – Itemized Deductions

Schedule B – Interest and Ordinary Dividends

Schedule C – Profit or Loss from Business

Schedule D – Capital Gains and Losses

Schedule E – Supplemental Income and Loss

Form 4562 – Depreciation and Amortization

Form 4797 – Sales of Business Property

Form 8582 – Passive Activity Loss Limitations

Form 8829 – Business Use of Home

Form 8949 – Sales and Other Dispositions of Capital Assets

Form 8995 / Form 8995-A – Qualified Business Income (QBI) Deduction

2. Business Tax Forms

Form 1120 – U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return

Form 1120-S – U.S. Income Tax Return for an S Corporation

Form 1065 – U.S. Return of Partnership Income

Form 1041 – U.S. Income Tax Return for Estates and Trusts

Form 941 – Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return

Form 940 – Employer's Annual Federal Unemployment (FUTA) Tax Return

Forms W-2 and W-3

Forms 1099-NEC, 1099-MISC, and 1099-INT

Form 1096 – Annual Summary and Transmittal of U.S. Information Returns



- Ability to identify missing tax documents and proactively follow up on open items with clients and internal team members until resolved

- Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and clearly with clients

- Strong organizational, project management, and time management skills

- High attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and quality

- Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

- Comfortable using cloud-based tax software, document management systems, and project management tools

- Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team

- Available to work full-time during U.S. business hours (9:00 AM CST – 6:00 PM CST)

- If you get invited to an interview, be ready to answer: What was the title of Jasmine’s most recent YoutTube video and what did you find interesting about it?



Our Core Values

1. Bring Fun Tax Energy

We're genuinely obsessed with tax — the rules, the strategy, the wins for clients — and that obsession is contagious. We show up with real energy, take pride in the work, and make the experience good for each other and for the client. A great attitude isn't soft; it makes the work better and the people around us better.

2. Speed Drives Results

We love to win, and winning means getting it done. Immediately. We learn fast, adapt fast, and move — because knowing the answer isn't the job, acting on it is. Momentum compounds: the faster we turn knowledge into action, the better the outcome for the client and the firm.

3. Own the Outcome

The result is yours, full stop. We don't love excuses, even if they are real — we love getting results. We don't hand off problems, we solve them. We follow through on what we said we'd do, and when something's in the way, we do what it takes to get it done. No "not my job."

title: Appointment Setter – U.S. Clients (Part-time, $6/hr + bonuses, training provided)
description:
Apply here: 



Steadfast Commercial Cleaning is a commercial cleaning company in Columbus, Ohio. We’re hiring a part-time appointment setter to call small U.S. offices (dental practices, medical and vet clinics, professional offices) and book walkthroughs. You don’t need U.S. business experience. We train you on our script. What we look for is clear, natural English on the phone and the persistence to keep a conversation going when someone says no.



What you’ll do



Call U.S. offices from our list and reach the office manager or owner

Stay calm and keep going when you hear “we already have a cleaner” or “just send me an
”, and end every call with a name and a date

Book walkthroughs at a specific day and time. Our local cleaner does the walkthrough, and the owner delivers the quote.

Follow up after the quote until the client signs



Pay (USD, paid every Sunday)



$6/hour, 25 hours a week (about $650/month)

$20 for every walkthrough you book that takes place and gets a quote

$100 when that client pays its first invoice, plus $50 more at its third

A path to promotion to our closer role for setters who keep turning walkthroughs into clients



Hours: Monday–Friday, 9am–12pm and 1pm–3pm U.S. Eastern, with an unpaid hour in between (9pm–12am and 1am–3am Manila; one hour later after the U.S. clock change on Nov 1).



Must-haves



Clear, natural spoken English. We listen to a short voice recording when you apply.

Outbound calling or sales experience of any kind, and the willingness to follow our script and practise it

A computer, a headset that sounds clean on a call, backup internet and power, and a quiet room

No other job or client during these hours, and no setting for other cleaning companies



How to apply: complete our application at the link (about 8 minutes, including a short voice warm-up). Strong applicants are invited to a 9-minute recorded AI interview with two practice calls, then a call with the owner.

title: Client Relations and Separations - EWS Supervisor
description:
*** PS: Payrate Range is not negotiable so if you are expecting a higher Hourly rate please do not apply ***

*** We use Hubstaff as productivity and screen monitoring systems, please do not apply if you are not comfortable with this***



EWS Auditor



Early Warning System, Risk Management, Coaching & Retention



JOB SUMMARY



The EWS Supervisor oversees the Early Warning System (EWS) and is responsible for reviewing,

mitigating, and resolving identified VA risks that may lead to performance issues, client dissatisfaction,

termination, or separation.



CSMs are responsible for identifying and risk-tagging Yellow and Red cases, conducting the initial

check-in, and implementing the first-level intervention. The EWS Supervisor provides the next level of

support by reviewing flagged cases and intervening when risks are unresolved, escalating, recurring, or

require additional management support.



The EWS Supervisor assesses the situation, meets with the CSM and/or VA as needed, provides coaching,

conducts Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and develops an appropriate mitigation plan. Based on the findings

and progress, the EWS Supervisor may recommend resolution, continued monitoring, a Performance

Improvement Plan (PIP), or VA replacement.



The primary objective of the role is to reduce avoidable VA terminations and separations by addressing

risks early, identifying root causes, and driving effective corrective action.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

EWS & Risk Management

● Review Yellow and Red VA risk flags identified by CSMs.

● Prioritize unresolved, escalating, or high-risk cases.

● Assess whether additional EWS intervention is required.

● Monitor cases through resolution, escalation, or replacement.



Risk Intervention

● Meet with CSMs and/or VAs when additional intervention is required.

● Identify the underlying cause of the issue through assessment and RCA.

● Determine whether the issue is related to performance, capability, training, behavior, client

expectations, CSM execution, role alignment, or process.

● Develop and monitor the virtual assistant progress.

● Recommend the appropriate outcome based on documented findings: resolve, PIP, or replace.



Coaching & Performance Management

● Coach CSMs on risk management, difficult conversations, corrective action, and retention

strategies.

● Provide direct VA coaching when appropriate.

● Develop or support PIPs for documented performance concerns.

● Monitor improvement and escalate cases when corrective action is unsuccessful.



Incubation & Preventive Risk Management

● Provide heightened oversight of qualifying VA risks during the 0–30 day Incubation period.

● Support the 1st Week EWS intervention process for qualifying cases.

● Support preventive coaching and risk reviews for VAs within the 31–180 day period.



Reporting & Process Improvement

● Track EWS outcomes, intervention effectiveness, and separation trends and Analysis.

● Identify recurring risk drivers and recommend improvements to Client Success and Manager of

Client Relations and Separations



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

● Reduction in preventable VA terminations and separations of at least 15% monthly.

● Reduction in unresolved Yellow and Red cases.

● EWS intervention and resolution rate.

● 1st week resolution of high risk drivers for VAs on 0-30 days tenure

● Timely completion of required EWS interventions.

● Improvement in CSM risk-management and intervention effectiveness.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

● Experience as Client Success Manager can be considered

● Experience in coaching, performance management, and people development.

● Experience conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

● Experience developing or managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).

● Strong analytical, organizational, and case-management skills.

● Excellent written and verbal communication.

● Strong judgment and ability to make objective, evidence-based recommendations.

● Ability to manage sensitive performance and client matters professionally.

● Experience in legal services, legal staffing, law firm environments.

● Experience with escalation, retention, or separation-prevention programs.



OVERALL OBJECTIVE

The EWS Supervisor's primary objective is to mitigate identified VA risks before they become

terminations or separations by providing timely intervention, effective coaching, root cause analysis,

and measurable corrective action.

The CSM identifies the risk. The EWS Supervisor provides support to resolve it.
