title: Hiring: Skilled 3D Generalist Character Modeler/ Animator
description:
Long-Term Opportunity | Potential Full-Time Position | Indie Game Development



Job Description



We are independent game development studio seeking a talented, creative, and reliable 3D Generalist to assist with several ongoing video game projects.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable working across multiple areas of 3D development, including character modeling, environmental modeling, texturing, rigging, and animation.



This position is intended to develop into a full-time, long-term opportunity for the right candidate.



While specialists are welcome to apply, priority will be given to experienced 3D Generalists who demonstrate strong skills in modeling, high-quality texturing, and character animation.



Our projects primarily involve stylized anime-inspired visuals, immersive environments, and interactive gameplay systems developed in Unreal Engine.



Primary Responsibilities



1. 3D Character Modeling



- Create high-quality, stylized anime-inspired 3D characters from concept art and references.

- Model both male and female characters with accurate anatomy, proportions, and silhouettes.

- Create detailed clothing, hairstyles, accessories, and character variations.

- Develop characters suitable for real-time gameplay.

- Optimize character models while maintaining visual quality.

- Modify and improve existing 3D models when necessary.



2. Texturing and Materials



- Create detailed, professional-quality textures for characters, clothing, props, and environments.

- Work with stylized anime materials and realistic or semi-realistic textures when required.

- Produce clean UV maps and properly organized texture sets.

- Maintain consistent visual quality across different game assets.

- Understand PBR workflows and materials compatible with Unreal Engine.



Strong texturing abilities are extremely important for this position.



3. Character Rigging and Animation



- Rig humanoid characters for gameplay and cinematic sequences.

- Create smooth, natural character animations.

- Produce idle, walking, running, crouching, and other basic movement animations.

- Animate character interactions with environmental objects and other characters.

- Create expressive facial animations, gestures, and body language.

- Develop custom animations based on video references or provided examples.

- Create animations for horror, stealth, simulation, and narrative-driven gameplay.

- Work with existing skeletons and animation systems when possible.



Experience with animation retargeting and Unreal Engine skeleton compatibility is highly desirable.



4. Environmental Modeling and Props



- Create interior and exterior environments for video games.

- Model residential buildings, apartments, houses, stores, and other urban environments.

- Develop furniture, appliances, decorative objects, and interactive props.

- Create environmental assets for horror-themed locations, including mansions and abandoned buildings.

- Optimize environments for real-time performance.

- Work with existing marketplace assets and modify them to fit project requirements.



5. Game Asset Integration



- Prepare and export models for use in Unreal Engine. (And or other game engines as needed)

- Ensure models have appropriate topology, materials, UVs, and skeletal structures.

- Assist with importing and configuring character animations.

- Troubleshoot issues involving meshes, textures, and animation compatibility.

- Collaborate on asset optimization and organization.



Current Project Styles



Our development projects include:



Anime-Inspired Life Simulation



A stylized anime life simulator featuring interactive characters, residential neighborhoods, interior environments, and everyday activities.



Assets may include:



- Anime-style characters and alternate outfits.

- Everyday character animations and interactions.

- Residential buildings and neighborhood assets.

- Furniture, household appliances, and interactive objects.

- Character expressions and relationship-driven animations.



Stealth Horror



A horror experience featuring supernatural humanoid characters, detailed environments, and character-driven interactions.



Assets may include:



- Stylized supernatural and humanoid character models.

- Unique character animations and movement styles.

- Detailed mansion interiors and environmental props.

- Suspenseful character interactions and horror animations.

- Character outfits, accessories, and variations.



Multiplayer Survival Horror



An anime-inspired asymmetric survival horror experience.



Assets may include:



- Stylized playable characters.

- Character outfits and cosmetic variations.

- Movement, combat, and interaction animations.

- Environmental objects and map assets.

- Unique character-specific animations.



Preferred Qualifications



We are primarily interested in candidates who possess:



- 2–5+ years of demonstrable 3D development experience.

- Strong proficiency in Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, or comparable 3D software.

- Excellent character modeling and texturing abilities.

- Experience creating stylized anime-inspired characters.

- Practical knowledge of character rigging and animation.

- Familiarity with Unreal Engine workflows.

- Understanding of topology, UV mapping, and optimization.

- Ability to work independently using visual references and written instructions.

- Strong communication skills and professional reliability.

- Ability to provide regular progress updates and meet agreed-upon deadlines.



Experience creating complete game-ready characters, from modeling and texturing through rigging and animation, will receive the highest consideration.



Additional Skills That Are a Plus



- Unreal Engine 5 experience.

- Anime shaders and stylized material creation.

- Facial rigging and expression systems.

- Character clothing and accessory creation.

- Animation retargeting.

- Experience with marketplace assets.

- Blendshapes and morph targets.

- Basic understanding of game development pipelines.

- Experience with mature-rated video game projects.



Important Information



Some of our projects involve mature themes, horror, violence, and adult-oriented content.



Applicants should be comfortable working on projects intended for mature audiences.



Not every project involves mature content, and assignments will vary depending on development requirements.



Employment Opportunity



We are looking to establish a long-term working relationship with a dependable and talented artist.



The position may begin with individual assignments or a paid trial project to evaluate compatibility, work quality, and communication.



Our primary goal is to find the right candidate for consistent, potentially full-time employment.



We value reliability, communication, creativity, and attention to detail just as much as technical ability.



Candidates who consistently deliver quality work and demonstrate versatility will be prioritized for ongoing development opportunities.



How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Your portfolio showcasing your best 3D modeling, texturing, and animation work.

2. Your years of professional experience.

3. The 3D software you primarily use.

4. Your experience with Unreal Engine, if applicable.

5. Examples of completed, game-ready character models.

6. Examples of animations you personally created.

7. Your desired monthly salary or hourly rate for long-term employment.

8. Your availability for consistent or full-time work.



Important: Please specify which parts of your portfolio you personally created, particularly modeling, texturing, rigging, and animation.



Applications demonstrating strong abilities in all three priority areas, modeling, texturing, and animation, will receive preference.



We are particularly interested in artists who are passionate about independent game development and interested in growing alongside our projects.



Mandatory Paid Technical Assessment



All applicants considered for this position are required to complete a $100 paid technical assessment, without exception. This assessment is a mandatory part of our hiring process and allows us to evaluate each candidate's technical abilities, artistic quality, and suitability for our development team under consistent standards. We understand that candidates may have different expectations regarding assessment compensation; however, the payment and evaluation requirements are non-negotiable. Applicants who are uncomfortable with these terms are respectfully encouraged to refrain from applying. As a small independent development studio, we are committed to finding dedicated professionals who are genuinely interested in long-term employment opportunities and willing to demonstrate their capabilities through a practical, compensated evaluation. We value every applicant's time and expertise and ask that only those who are serious about pursuing this opportunity proceed with the application process.



We look forward to reviewing your work!

title: Staff Accountant
description:
Role: Part-Time Staff Accountant (U.S. Accounting, Inventory & Compliance)

Company: Michaud CPAs  

Employment: Part-time, long-term  

Hours: Approximately 15 hours per week  

Schedule: Working hours between 7:00 AM and 12:00 noon U.S. Eastern Time (EST/EDT)



About Us



Michaud CPAs is an accounting and fractional CFO firm providing outsourced accounting, financial reporting, and financial management services to growing U.S. businesses.



We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented accountant to join our remote accounting team.



You will primarily support an established U.S. brewery business, working closely with our Accounting Team Lead and another bookkeeper.



This is a hands-on accounting position involving inventory accounting, account reconciliations, specialized excise tax reporting, and month-end close procedures.



We are looking for someone with strong accounting fundamentals who can work independently, investigate discrepancies, and take responsibility for completing assigned tasks accurately and on schedule.



Key Responsibilities



1. Inventory and Operational Accounting

- Prepare and review inventory reconciliations.

- Reconcile inventory records between operational systems and accounting software.

- Investigate inventory discrepancies and recommend adjustments.

- Assist with cost-of-goods-sold calculations and reconciliations.

- Prepare supporting schedules and journal entries.

- Identify unusual transactions and resolve accounting discrepancies.



2. Excise Tax and Regulatory Reporting

- Prepare recurring federal TTB excise tax calculations and filings relating to malt beverages, spirits, and wine/cider, as applicable.

- Prepare applicable Virginia ABC tax reports and related regulatory reporting.

- Reconcile tax calculations with inventory, production, and accounting records.

- Maintain accurate supporting schedules and documentation.

- Track filing deadlines and ensure that reports are prepared on time.

- Submit completed calculations and filing documentation for review and approval.



Previous experience with brewery excise tax reporting is an advantage but is not required. Training and established procedures will be provided.



This position does not involve preparing U.S. federal or state income tax returns.



3. Month-End Close and General Accounting

- Prepare assigned balance sheet reconciliations.

- Investigate and resolve differences between subsidiary records and general ledger balances.

- Prepare adjusting journal entries and supporting schedules.

- Assist with month-end accruals, prepayments, and other accounting adjustments.

- Support the Accounting Team Lead with monthly financial reporting.

- Maintain accurate records and complete assigned tasks according to the month-end close calendar.



4. Accounting Systems and Team Support

- Help investigate and resolve complex accounting system integration issues.

- Provide backup support for bookkeeping activities when necessary.

- Assist with reviewing transactions, researching discrepancies, and improving accounting processes.

- Maintain organized workpapers and clear documentation.

- Communicate proactively with the Accounting Team Lead regarding outstanding issues and approaching deadlines.



Required Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in accounting or a related field.

- At least three years of professional accounting experience.

- Strong understanding of accrual accounting and financial statement preparation.

- Experience working with U.S.-based businesses or accounting firms.

- Demonstrated experience preparing account reconciliations and month-end journal entries.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online or comparable accounting software.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

- Ability to investigate and independently resolve accounting discrepancies.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications

- Five or more years of relevant accounting experience.

- Experience with inventory accounting, manufacturing, or cost-of-goods-sold reconciliations.

- Experience preparing indirect tax, excise tax, or other recurring regulatory filings.

- Experience reconciling information between multiple accounting and operational systems.

- Experience working with breweries, manufacturers, or other inventory-intensive businesses.

- Philippine CPA qualification is an advantage but is not required.



Work Schedule and Compensation



- Approximately 15 hours per week.

- Working hours must fall between 7:00 AM and 12:00 noon U.S. Eastern Time.

- Some flexibility in the distribution of weekly hours may be required, particularly during month-end close and regulatory filing periods.

- Compensation: $9–$12 USD per hour, depending on experience.

- Long-term opportunity with an established accounting firm.



We are looking for someone who can commit to a consistent schedule and accommodate the heavier accounting workload that occurs during the first half of each month.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your résumé and a summary of your accounting experience.

2. Your experience working with U.S. businesses or accounting firms.

3. A description of your month-end close and balance sheet reconciliation experience.

4. Any experience with inventory accounting, cost of goods sold, excise taxes, or regulatory reporting.

5. Your experience with accounting software and system integrations.

6. Your expected hourly rate and weekly availability.

7. Confirmation that you can work during the required U.S. Eastern Time hours.



**Please also answer the following questions:**



Question 1: During month-end close, the inventory balance in the general ledger does not agree with the inventory valuation report from an operational system. Explain how you would investigate the discrepancy.



Question 2: You are responsible for preparing a recurring excise tax filing. The current month's reported quantities are significantly different from the previous month. What steps would you take before finalizing the filing?



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and a technical accounting assessment.

title: E-Commerce Developer: Kickflip Customizer Build, GMC Variant Feeds, WooCommerce Plugin Audit & Shopify Migration
description:
We are an established custom golf gear and apparel manufacturing brand currently operating on WooCommerce. We are seeking a skilled e-commerce developer with hands-on experience building visual product configurators and troubleshooting complex feed architectures. Our immediate priorities are building our interactive product builder on Kickflip, solving Google Merchant Center product variation feed issues and bot crawling bottlenecks, cleaning up our current WooCommerce plugin stack, and preparing for an eventual migration to Shopify. In order to be considered, when you apply to this job write the word yothar in the subject line when you contact us and include an audio file or link of you talking so that we can hear your English prior to interviewing you.





Core Responsibilities (In Order of Priority):

1) Kickflip Product Configurator Build-Out (Primary Focus):

*Work on the setup, asset mapping, and conditional logic configuration for our custom golf headcovers and gear inside the Kickflip platform.

*Configure multi-view options, color palettes, material layers, text personalization, and custom logo upload features.

*Ensure customizer output cleanly maps print-ready production files, preview render URLs, and line-item properties directly into the cart and checkout payloads.



2) WooCommerce Plugin Audit & Conflict Resolution:

*Audit our current WordPress/WooCommerce plugin stack (SiteGround environment) to eliminate redundancies, database bloat, and filter/hook conflicts.

*Safely deprecate, remove, or consolidate unnecessary plugins without breaking checkout workflows or our live conversion tracking.

title: Sales Development Rep (SDR) | Book Meetings With US Agency Owners | Only 4 Hours of Night-Shift Calling
description:
You'll be calling US agency owners with one of the easiest offers to say yes to in B2B sales. We put up the money. They only pay when qualified sales meetings we booked for their sales teams happen.



ABOUT AXION



Axion is a performance-based pipeline partner for US marketing agencies. We fund and run the campaigns and SDR teams that put qualified business owners on our partners' sales calendars, using the same playbooks behind our own agencies.



Our partners pay only when a qualified owner shows up to a meeting with their sales team. No retainers, no setup fees, no long-term contracts. We invest our own capital first and only get paid when our partners do.



Feel free to learn more about Axion at 
 



THE ROLE



You'll book the first conversation between a marketing agency CEO and Axion.



Half your day is on the phone with agency owners across the US. The other half is research: finding the agencies we want to work with and building the list you call. Your job is to start the right conversations and get great agencies onto our calendar. Our team handles the rest.



Why this role stands out:



- Only 4 hours of night shift. Your calling block is 10am to 2pm US Eastern (currently 10pm to 2am Philippine time). Your research hours are yours to schedule.

- An offer owners want to hear. Agencies take on zero risk and pay only for meetings that happen. That makes every cold call warmer.

- One company, one offer. No rotating client campaigns. You'll learn this offer deeply and get very good at it.

- Direct coaching. You work directly with Adam, our VP of Partner Success, with a short huddle before every calling block and a recap after.

- Real growth. Hit your targets for 90 days and you move to Senior SDR with a higher base and bigger bonuses. The Axion team is constantly growing, and leadership roles go to the people already here.



WHAT A DAY LOOKS LIKE



- Research (about 4 hours, on your schedule): find US marketing agencies through Google and LinkedIn, check what they sell, review their case studies, confirm their US team size, and add the strong ones to your list.

- Huddle (15 minutes): role-play, objections, and the plan for the day.

- Calling block (10am to 2pm Eastern): call agency owners and CEOs, send follow-up
s, leave voi
s, and book fit calls onto our calendar.

- Recap (15 minutes): your numbers, your best calls, and what to sharpen tomorrow.



PAY



- $700/month base, in USD

- $25 for every qualified fit call you book that shows up

- $150 for every agency you book that becomes a partner within 6 months

- Senior SDR after 90 days at target: $900/month base, $35 per attended fit call, $200 per new partner

- Paid twice a month, straight to your Wise/Payoneer account

- At target, new SDRs earn about $1,100 to $1,400 a month



WHO YOU ARE



You're competitive. You take coaching and use it on your very next call. A "no" doesn't slow you down. You're curious about how marketing agencies grow, and you want a long-term role with a company you can grow inside.



REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent spoken English that sounds natural to US business owners

- B2B cold calling or appointment setting experience with US companies (strongly preferred)

- An active LinkedIn account

- Wired headset and a quiet place to work

- Reliable internet, plus a backup plan if your power or internet drops

- A computer that runs Chrome with several tabs open

- Available Monday to Friday, 10am to 2pm US Eastern



HOW TO APPLY



We listen to every recording before we read anything else. Send all of the following:



1. Subject line: Axion SDR | [Your Name]

2. A voice recording of you reading the script below. Upload it to Google Drive or Vocaroo and paste the link. Say it the way you would on a live call.

3. Your LinkedIn profile link

4. Short answers to these questions:

   a. Tell us about your cold calling experience: who you called, what you booked, and your best month.

   b. An agency owner tells you, "We get all our clients from referrals." What do you say next?

   c. What's your backup if your internet or power goes out during your shift?

   d. What's a goal you're working toward right now, and how would this role help you get there?



Applications without a recording won't be reviewed.



SCRIPT FOR YOUR RECORDING



"Hi Mark, this is [your name] with Axion. I know I'm calling out of the blue, so I'll be quick. We work with marketing agencies that already have a strong sales team and want more qualified prospects on their sales team’s calendars. We fund the outreach ourselves, and agencies only pay for the meetings that are qualified and actually show. I'm not calling to sell you anything today. I just wanted to see if it makes sense to set up a quick 15-minute call this week to see if we're a fit. Would Thursday or Friday work better for you?"



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. Shortlisted applicants hear from us within 2 business days.

2. A 15-minute live call with a quick role-play.

3. If it's a fit, you start with one focused, paid training day.

4. Day two, you're on the phones.



We're hiring this week.

title: AI Talking Avatar Video Creator (Google Flow OMNI + CapCut) - 6 videos/day, long-term
description:
Watch this video first. This is the job:





Everything in it is AI. The man talking, his voice and every shot were made with OMNI in Google Flow, then cut together in CapCut. It got 12,000 likes and 2,300 comments because nobody scrolling past can tell it is AI.



I need someone who can make 6 videos like that every day.



WHAT MAKES THAT VIDEO WORK (and what you will be judged on)



- It looks like a normal person filmed it on their phone. Not cinematic, not polished, not "AI looking".

- It is the same man in every shot: same face, same hair, same clothes, same voice.

- His lips match every word. Nothing is cut off, nothing is doubled.

- What you see matches what he says. When he talks about ginger, there is ginger in his hand.

- He holds the real product on camera, label to the lens.

- The captions are clean and on time, and the music is quiet under his voice.



If you look at that video and think "I already make videos like this", keep reading. If you think "I could learn this", this job is not for you yet. I am not training anyone from zero.



YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE



1. Hands-on experience making talking clips with OMNI in Google Flow. Veo only, Kling, HeyGen or Higgsfield does not count.

2. At least 3 months of paid AI avatar video work for a client or brand.

3. At least 50 finished AI videos delivered (finished videos, not clips).

4. Solid CapCut: captions, keyframes, audio ducking, cutting to the beat of the voice.

5. Proof you have kept one character consistent across several videos.



A NORMAL DAY



The day before, I send you everything for each video: the script, a reference video, the character image and the start frames. You then:



1. Generate each line as its own Omni clip, from the start frame, one clip at a time.

2. Check every clip: face, voice, lip sync, every word said exactly as written. Redo any that fail.

3. Put the clips together in CapCut with captions and quiet background music, matching the reference video's pacing and shot order.

4. Export 9:16, 1080x1920 MP4 and upload each video as soon as it is done.



Videos are 1 to 2 minutes long. Week 1 is 4 to 5 videos a day while I check your workflow. After that it is 6.



OMNI SKILLS I EXPECT ON DAY ONE



- Frames mode (not Ingredients) so the clip starts on the exact image

- Short dialogue prompts: the action, the speaker, the delivery and the exact line, nothing else

- Choosing 4s, 6s or 8s to fit the line, so no words are cut off and there is no dead air

- Rewording a blocked prompt (filter / "reputational risk") without changing the spoken line

- x1 generations only, checked one at a time



CREDITS



Accounts and credits are provided. Images are free, so the start frame gets perfected first. Clips cost credits, so: shortest length that fits the line, never 10s, never x2/x3/x4, never 16:9. Screenshot the credit balance at the start and end of each day. Wasting credits is the fastest way off the team.



HOW I CHECK YOU ARE REAL



- You show me your Omni history in Flow on a screen share or a short screen recording.

- You make ONE paid test video from my script and assets before you are hired. Same quality as the example.

- I get the same recycled portfolios from different people every week. If you cannot prove the work is yours, you are out.



CONSISTENCY



Same hours and same days every week, Saturdays included. 3 strikes: missing a day without telling me first is a strike, and repeating a mistake after feedback is a strike. You need a computer that can export 6 videos a day and reliable internet.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "OMNI" or I will not read it. Then answer:



1. Link 2 to 3 talking avatar videos you made yourself with Omni. For each: which client or brand, and what you did.

2. How long have you used Omni, and about how many finished videos have you delivered with it?

3. Watch my example video. In 2 to 3 sentences, how would you rebuild it in Omni?

4. Tell me about one Omni clip that got blocked, cut off a word or drifted from the start frame, and how you fixed it.

5. Link one character you kept consistent across 2 or more videos.

6. Honestly, how many 1 to 2 minute videos can you finish per day at the example's quality?

7. Your working hours and the days you commit to.



No Omni videos, no reply. AI-written copy-paste applications that do not answer the questions get no reply either.



WHAT YOU GET



- Everything prepared for you the day before: scripts, references, character images, start frames

- My exact process and prompt library, plus Loom feedback

- Accounts and credits paid for

- Long-term stable work, a raise as you get faster, and a monthly performance bonus

title: Loan Officer Assistant (LOA) / Junior Mortgage Processor
description:
Ready to make your next career move?

Apply directly through our careers page: 
/careers/apply



About the Company:

BrokerVA is a specialized virtual assistant and operations support company dedicated exclusively to the mortgage industry. Designed to help mortgage brokers and lenders scale efficiently, the company provides trained, experienced mortgage professionals who integrate seamlessly into existing operations.



About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Loan Officer Assistant (LOA) / Junior Mortgage Processor with hands-on experience in the U.S. mortgage industry. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of borrower financial analysis, loan program eligibility, and the initial stages of the mortgage origination and processing workflow.



This role requires someone who can independently review loan applications, identify potential red flags, determine documentation needs, and prepare files for submission to underwriting. Experience working with wholesale lenders and broker-side mortgage operations is highly preferred.



Key Responsibilities

- Income Calculation and Analysis: Calculate and analyze borrower income, with a strong emphasis on self-employed borrowers, including reviewing tax returns, profit and loss statements, and other supporting financial documents.

- Borrower Financial Review: Evaluate credit reports, assets, liabilities, and income documentation to assess borrower qualifications and identify suitable loan programs.

- Loan Program Analysis: Identify potential loan options based on borrower qualifications, including Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and Non-QM, as applicable.

- Initial File Review: Identify red flags, discrepancies, missing information, and potential qualification issues during the initial review.

- Needs List Preparation: Request additional documentation and prepare clear, comprehensive needs lists to address outstanding items before submission.

- Loan Registration: Register loan files through various wholesale lender portals, such as UWM, Rocket Mortgage, PennyMac, TPO, Newrez, and other investors.

- Pricing and Initial Disclosures: Understand mortgage pricing and assist with preparing the initial Loan Estimate (LE) for disclosure, following applicable procedures and compliance requirements.

- Automated Underwriting System (AUS): Run and review AUS findings, identify eligibility issues or warnings, and help resolve findings by addressing documentation gaps or other concerns.

- Document Management: Upload, organize, and index loan documents in the appropriate loan origination system (LOS) and lender portals.

- Third-Party Orders: Order and track third-party services and documentation, such as title, appraisal, homeowners insurance, and other required reports.

- Document Review and Condition Preparation: Review documents received from borrowers and third parties to determine whether they adequately address anticipated underwriting requirements.

- Underwriting Submission: Prepare complete and properly documented loan files and submit them to underwriting through the appropriate lender portal.



Qualifications and Requirements

- At least 2 year of hands-on experience in U.S. mortgage origination, preferably in an LOA, Junior Processor, Loan Setup, or Mortgage Processing role.

- Strong knowledge of U.S. mortgage documentation and the loan origination process.

- Demonstrated experience calculating and analyzing income, especially for self-employed borrowers.

- Familiarity with borrower qualification guidelines and major mortgage loan programs.

- Experience registering loans through wholesale lender portals, preferably UWM, Rocket Mortgage, PennyMac, TPO, and Newrez.

- Working knowledge of mortgage pricing, initial Loan Estimates, and disclosure procedures.

- Experience running and interpreting AUS findings, such as DU and LPA.

- Familiarity with document uploading, indexing, third-party orders, and underwriting submission requirements.

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, U.S.-based mortgage environment.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working on the broker/wholesale lending side, particularly with non-delegated lenders.

- Familiarity with mortgage LOS platforms such as Encompass, LendingPad, Arive, or similar systems.

- Experience reviewing complex self-employed income documentation and resolving initial loan qualification issues.

- Ability to manage files with minimal supervision and prepare them for underwriting without extensive training.



What We’re Looking For

We need someone who understands more than basic administrative support. The ideal candidate should be comfortable reviewing borrower financials, calculating income, evaluating loan eligibility, identifying potential issues, and preparing mortgage files for underwriting.



Candidates must have relevant, hands-on U.S. mortgage experience and be ready to apply their knowledge with minimal supervision.



Benefits:

- Permanent Work-From-Home Setup

- HMO Coverage (Employee + 2 Dependents)

- 13th Month Pay

- Paid Time Off (PTO)

- Philippine Holiday Premium Pay

- Annual Bonus

- Company Team Gatherings and Events

- Supportive and Collaborative Team Environment

title: Ecommerce Product Researcher & Competitor Analyst

We’re looking for a highly motivated Ecommerce Product Researcher & Competitor Analyst to join our team and help us find and validate winning products as we head into Q4.



This is a high-ownership role. You’ll work directly with the Founder and Operations Lead, and your research will help determine which products we test, launch, and scale.



What you’ll do:



• Research and find potential winning ecommerce products

• Monitor TikTok, Kalodata, competitor stores, social media, and emerging trends

• Analyze competitors, market demand, saturation, pricing, ads, and creative

• Determine whether a product has realistic potential to compete and scale

• Present your strongest product opportunities and explain your reasoning

• Identify products that look promising but should actually be avoided

• Track all research, products, competitors, and decisions in Google Sheets

• Source TikTok videos, B-roll, UGC, competitor creatives, and other content for approved products

• Work closely with the Operations Lead to move products from research to launch

• Keep the product pipeline organized and always know the status of every opportunity



What we’re looking for:



• Strong research and analytical skills

• Curious and naturally driven to investigate products and trends

• Good understanding of ecommerce and online shopping behavior

• Highly organized and detail-oriented

• Able to work independently and take ownership

• Comfortable with direct feedback and criticism

• Persistent and able to handle many failed ideas before finding a winner

• Fast learner who can adapt to new research methods and tools

• Strong communication and documentation skills

• Available and responsive 7 days a week, especially during Q4



Ecommerce or product research experience is a plus, but we’re also open to someone who has strong research skills and the right mindset.



Compensation:



$1,000/month + possible equity.



There is potential for additional upside based on the value and results generated from the products you help identify.



This is not a traditional low-pressure 9-to-5 role. We’re looking for someone who wants to take ownership, move quickly, and be part of a team that is actively scaling ecommerce brands.



How to Apply:



Please include the following in your application:



One ecommerce product you believe is a winner right now. Explain why, who is already selling it, how saturated the market is, and whether we could realistically compete.

One product that looks like a winner but you believe is actually a bad opportunity. Explain what you researched, what red flags you found, and why you rejected it.

Tell us what you’re currently doing, your relevant experience, and how many hours per week you can realistically commit.

Professional engineering qualifications are not required. We provide product knowledge and technical training.



Key Responsibilities

 Communication

title: Part-Time QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper (Two U.S. LLCs)
description:
Rate: $12 USD per hour. This rate reflects that we're hiring for experience. If you're early in your bookkeeping career, this role isn't the right fit yet.

Hours: About 12 hours per month, worked in two scheduled windows

Schedule: Flexible hours. You set your own time as long as each deadline is met

Time tracking: All work is logged in Time Doctor (required)

Reports to: Brett Williamson, Founder and CEO of Ad Genius



ABOUT US

Ad Genius is a boutique digital marketing agency based in Phoenix, Arizona. We help established home service companies (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing and more) keep their phones ringing and their crews working. We have an established specialist team in the U.S., Canada and the Philippines, and we value people who own their work and communicate clearly.



You will keep the books for two U.S. companies: Ad Genius LLC, and a second, very low-volume LLC for a vacation rental that takes about an hour a month.



THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced bookkeeper who can take full ownership of our monthly books in QuickBooks Online. This is not data entry. We want someone who can reconcile every account to the penny, spot problems before we do, and deliver a clean, on-time close without being told what to do next.



MONTHLY SCHEDULE (ABOUT 12 HOURS)

- By the 21st (about 4 hours): categorize and review transactions for the 1st through the 15th of the current month, match Stripe payouts to invoices, and flag anything unclear.

- By the 6th (about 8 hours): categorize the 16th through month-end, reconcile all bank and credit card accounts to their statements for both companies, tie out payroll, and send the monthly reports.



All deadlines are U.S. Arizona time (MST, which does not change for daylight saving). The first month will include extra paid hours for setup and cleanup.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Categorize transactions accurately using our chart of accounts and bank rules

- Reconcile all bank and credit card accounts to their monthly statements

- Match Stripe payouts to customer invoices, recording gross sales, processing fees, and net deposits correctly

- Record and tie out payroll for our U.S. employees

- Record payments to contractors in the U.S. and abroad, and keep U.S. contractor records ready for year-end 1099 filing

- Keep the two companies completely separate, and flag any transaction that crosses between them instead of guessing how to record it

- Send a monthly P&L, balance sheet and reconciliation summary for each company by the 6th

- Track your time in Time Doctor by company and by pass, and ask before going over the 12-hour monthly cap



TIME TRACKING (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

We use Time Doctor for every hour worked on our companies. It records active time and activity while you work, so we can both see that paid hours went to focused work on our books. This is how we keep things fair, clear and simple:

- Only time tracked in Time Doctor is paid

- Time Doctor runs whenever you work on our books, and only then

- Each session is focused on our companies. Please do not work for other clients while tracking our time

- Please keep personal browsing and unrelated apps closed while tracking



If you are not comfortable working with Time Doctor, this role is not the right fit, and we would rather you know that up front.



REQUIREMENTS

- 3 or more years of bookkeeping for U.S. small businesses, including at least 2 years hands-on in QuickBooks Online

- You currently own the full month-end close (reconciliations through financial statements) for at least one U.S. business

- Degree in accounting or a related field

- Strong, current command of QuickBooks Online, including reconciliations and bank rules

- Experience reconciling Stripe or a similar payment processor

- Experience keeping books for more than one company or entity

- Clear written English and the habit of asking good questions in writing

- Proven record of meeting monthly deadlines without reminders

- Willingness to track all work in Time Doctor

- Reliable internet and a secure, private work setup



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification

- Accounting degree or CPA (Philippines)

- Experience with U.S. payroll entries and 1099 contractor tracking

- Experience with service businesses or marketing agencies

- Prior experience working with Time Doctor or a similar time tracker



HOW WE WORK

- Async first. Most communication happens in writing in Slack, so you do not need to match U.S. hours

- You will have your own QuickBooks Online login with access limited to what the job needs. We never share bank logins

- Clear expectations, a monthly checklist you own, and on-time pay for every tracked hour

- Long-term role for the right person, with room to grow as our needs grow



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word RECONCILED so we know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be reviewed. Then answer these questions:

1. How many years have you used QuickBooks Online, and are you a certified ProAdvisor?

2. Briefly describe how you would record a Stripe payout of $4,850 that came from $5,000 in invoices.

3. Your bank account is $212.40 off from the statement at month-end. Walk us through how you find the difference.

4. How many companies do you currently keep books for, and how do you manage their deadlines?

5. Can you commit to the 6th and 21st deadlines every month?

6. Have you worked with Time Doctor or another time tracker before, and are you comfortable using it for all work on our companies?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short, paid QuickBooks Online skills test before a final interview.

About Us

We’re a growing US e-commerce brand selling emergency preparedness products like water filtration and survival gear. Our customers are real people with real reasons for buying, and we want to hear those reasons directly from them.



The Role

You’ll call our existing customers and have friendly, natural conversations with them to understand:



Why they bought from us and what pushed them to buy

What problems, worries, or situations led them to look for our products

What they like, what they don’t, and what almost stopped them from buying

How they describe our products in their own words

Follow a question guide while keeping the conversation natural and relaxed

Ask follow-up questions to get specific, detailed answers

Record clear, organized notes after every call, using the customer’s own words where possible

Share recurring themes and standout insights with the team each week



Requirements



Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent that US customers can easily understand. This is the most important requirement.

Strong written English for call notes

Friendly, confident phone presence, and comfort talking with strangers

A good listener who is genuinely curious and knows how to dig deeper

Reliable internet, a quiet work space, and a good headset

Available during US business hours



Nice to Have



Experience in customer service, market research, surveys, or call center work

Experience with US customers

title: Maintenance Operations Coordinator
description:
Maintenance Operations Coordinator (EA-Caliber)

Philippines-based · Full-time · Independent contractor · Maintenance dispatch run to executive-assistant standards of tracking & reporting

Engagement

Independent contractor (you invoice us; you handle your own taxes)

Location

Remote, Philippines-based

Hours

Full shift 7:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. U.S. Pacific 



Reports to

The Owner directly, coordinating closely with our maintenance dispatch lead

Tools provided

AppFolio, Vonage, a shared work-order tracker/schedule, chat (e.g., Viber/WhatsApp),
 & calendar

About Us

A Los Angeles property management company managing a large residential portfolio. Our maintenance operation moves a high volume of work every week, and we need one person to own that pipeline end to end.

The Role

This is a maintenance role run to executive-assistant standards. You dispatch our in-house crew and own the master catalog of every work order — in-house and third-party — with the rigor of a great EA: a flawless tracking system, relentless follow-through until every item closes, and a daily close-out that keeps the Owner fully informed. You run the maintenance operation day to day and report up to the Owner on it. This is not a personal-assistant role — your focus is the maintenance function; the “EA” standard is how well you track, follow through, and report. Nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.

You are the central hub of the maintenance operation. Intake, the dispatch lead, the maintenance coordinator, the portfolio supervisors, the outside-vendor assistant, and the handymen each own a piece — you are the one person who makes sure every piece actually closes. The Owner can turn to you at any moment and get an accurate, complete picture of where everything stands. Your organization and follow-through are what keep the whole team accountable.

You dispatch a crew of 8 in-house handymen and catalog a high volume of work orders each week across the portfolio — plumbing, electrical, carpentry, HVAC, painting, masonry/tiling, and general maintenance. Third-party vendor coordination is handled by a separate assistant; you still ensure their work orders are logged and their status stays current in the master tracker.

What You'll Do

● Own the maintenance inboxes & AppFolio. Monitor the maintenance inbox(es) and AppFolio as the front door for every request — from residents, staff, the answering service, and AppFolio work orders — logging and categorizing each one the moment it arrives so it’s ready to schedule. AppFolio is your system of record.

● Keep the crew fully and productively worked. Proactively plan and assign each of the 8 handymen’s work one to two days ahead — matching jobs to skills, property/location, and priority — so no one is ever sitting idle or unsure what’s next. Rebuild the day when a job falls through, backfilling with the next-priority order, and work closely with the team to keep everyone moving.

● Use genuine downtime for back-office support. When the morning prep is done and the crew is dispatched, put spare time toward other work for the Owner — preparing and organizing billing and invoices, reconciling records, drafting correspondence and
s, and similar administrative tasks. This is secondary: it fills real downtime and never comes before dispatch, keeping the catalog current, or emergencies. (You prepare and organize; you do not approve or release any payment.)

● Handle evening & overnight emergencies. You are available for emergency maintenance calls from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.   When an emergency comes in, assess urgency, dispatch the on-call handyman or vendor, keep the resident informed, notify the Owner, and log it.

● Own the master work-order catalog. Make sure every work order — in-house and third-party vendor — is logged, categorized (Electrical, Plumbing, Carpentry, Painting, HVAC, Masonry & Tiling, or General Maintenance), and tracked with status (New, Assigned, Scheduled, Completed), assignee, unit/property, and date. You are the single source of truth for what exists and where it stands.

● Keep vendor orders current (tracking only). The outside-vendor assistant coordinates the vendors; you make sure their work orders are captured in the tracker and their status is updated, so nothing lives outside the catalog.

● Chase everything to closed — and hold the team accountable. Follow up on every open and overdue order, in-house or vendor, until it closes. When a job needs sign-off, route it to the right portfolio supervisor and stay on it until you have their approval. Keep intake, the coordinator, the supervisors, and the handymen moving on their pieces, and escalate high-priority or aging items to the Owner. Treat a second follow-up as an automatic escalation.

● Report like an EA. Send the Owner a daily end-of-shift close-out (what came in, what was dispatched, what’s overdue, tomorrow’s priorities) and a weekly aging review of anything not yet closed, plus monthly volume/vendor reporting. The Owner should never have to ask where something stands.

● Communicate & coordinate across the team. Work hand in hand with Maintenance Intake, the Maintenance Coordinator, the dispatch lead, the portfolio supervisors, and the outside-vendor assistant. Draft maintenance
s during the early block for the team to send when the U.S. day begins, handle maintenance correspondence with residents, staff, and vendors clearly and professionally, and keep the Owner informed with discretion on resident and personnel matters.

What We're Looking For

The one thing that matters most: this role lives or dies on follow-through. We are looking for someone with a proven, flawless system for tracking every open item to completion. Expect to describe it in your application and demonstrate it live in the interview.

● A flawless tracking system — the most important trait. You run every work order and every handyman’s schedule through a real, disciplined system with a defined tool and daily routine — never your memory. Nothing you are responsible for is ever lost or forgotten. In the interview you will be asked to show us this system and walk through what’s open on it right now.

● EA-level communication & reporting. You write clearly and professionally enough to correspond with residents, staff, and vendors and to produce a clean, useful daily close-out for the Owner.

● Closure mindset. You are wired to chase open items to done and escalate the moment something stalls — you find satisfaction in an empty overdue list, not just a busy day.

● A hub, not a silo. You are comfortable being the person everyone else’s work routes through — coordinating across intake, supervisors, vendors, and the crew, and politely holding people accountable to their part without friction.

● Proactive, not reactive. You get ahead of the work — the crew always knows what’s next and approvals are chased before they become blockers — rather than waiting to be asked.

● High-volume accuracy — you manage many concurrent, detail-sensitive orders and 8 people’s schedules without losing track or making errors.

● Clear spoken English — you’ll coordinate with handymen, residents, and staff by phone and chat every day, including calm handling of overnight and early-morning emergency calls. This is load-bearing, not optional.

● Strong written English — clear reports and correspondence to leadership, vendors, and residents.

● Comfort directing and following up — confidently assigning work to the crew and staying on an order until it’s done.

● Spreadsheet skill — Excel or Google Sheets (filtering, formulas, pivot tables); AppFolio experience a strong plus.

● Construction or trades knowledge — a background in construction, a skilled trade, or hands-on maintenance so you understand the work being dispatched: what a job actually involves, roughly how long it should take, what materials or specialty vendor it needs, and whether something is routine or an emergency.

● A plus: hands-on construction or skilled-trade experience (or having run a crew); prior experience dispatching or scheduling a field crew, or supporting a maintenance, facilities, or property-management function.

The Boundaries of This Role

For clarity and trust, this role explicitly does NOT include:

● Approval authority over money — you prepare and reconcile invoices; you do not approve, release, or make payments.

● Banking-portal access, wire initiation, check printing, or card credentials.

● Signature authority or committing the company to vendor contracts.

● Legal or rent-control work product; owner-relationship or commercial-terms decisions.

What Success Looks Like

● Work orders move New → Assigned → Scheduled → Completed with minimal delay and none falling through the cracks.

● The Owner and dispatch lead always have one accurate, up-to-date picture of every open order — in-house and vendor — by category, property, and status.

● The 8 handymen stay productively scheduled a day or two ahead, with same-day gaps filled quickly and end-of-day status captured.

● Every request is captured at intake, and after-hours emergencies are handled quickly and calmly — dispatched, logged, and escalated to the Owner.

How to Apply — Read Carefully

To be considered, your application MUST include all of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.

#

Include with your application

1

Internet speed proof — a Speedtest.net screenshot showing at least 25 Mbps download.

2

Your system (most important) — in your own words, describe in detail the exact system you use so that nothing you are responsible for is ever forgotten — specifically how you would schedule 8 people’s daily work and track every open work order from intake to completion. Name the tool, the routine, and how you know at a glance what is still open or overdue. If you advance, you will walk us through this system live.

3

A short judgment answer — Two quick scenarios: (a) You’re preparing the morning dispatch and one of the 8 handymen calls in sick while a resident reports no hot water — how do you re-plan the day? (b) It’s 3:00 a.m. Pacific and a resident calls reporting water leaking from the ceiling — what do you do?

4

Two short answers — (a) Describe your experience scheduling people, dispatching a crew, or coordinating high-volume work orders. (b) Your internet provider and backup plan for outages.

5

Your rate in USD and earliest availability.

Why these? They mirror the actual work. Strong applications move to a short skills exercise, a video interview, and reference checks.

Our Process

● Application review against the requirements above.

● Skills exercise (a realistic dispatch + work-order tracking exercise).

● Video interview (including a short phone role-play) · reference checks · offer.

title: Senior Sales & Property Operations Manager
description:
Senior Sales & Property Operations Manager

Remote | Full-Time



Salary: $1,500–$2,000 USD per month + Quarterly Performance Bonuses



We are a growing Irish property marketing and accommodation services business seeking an exceptionally capable, experienced and commercially minded professional to take a leading role in our daily sales and customer operations.



We are looking for someone who can think independently, understand customer behaviour, communicate confidently and take genuine ownership of their responsibilities.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant or basic customer support position.



You will be dealing with homeowners considering listing their properties for major international sporting events. The role involves managing customer relationships, handling enquiries and objections, following up on interested prospects and helping convert opportunities into paid listings.



We require someone who can balance professionalism, empathy and strong sales judgement without relying on aggressive selling techniques.



## Key Responsibilities



- Take responsibility for daily customer communication through WhatsApp Business and
.

- Manage a high volume of enquiries from homeowners throughout Ireland and the UK.

- Understand individual customer requirements, concerns and objections, and respond appropriately.

- Guide interested homeowners through our property listing services and payment process.

- Follow up consistently and professionally with prospective customers, ensuring valuable opportunities are not overlooked.

- Identify high-intent prospects and prioritise conversations with the greatest potential.

- Coordinate property photographs, descriptions, customer details and listing preparations.

- Maintain organised records of customer conversations, pending decisions, payments and follow-up requirements.

- Handle occasional telephone calls with homeowners when necessary.

- Conduct relevant research into property locations, accommodation features, local amenities and customer requirements.

- Provide accurate daily updates on customer enquiries, sales progress and outstanding tasks.

- Take initiative, identify problems and recommend improvements to the operation.



## Experience & Qualifications



A minimum of five years of relevant professional experience is required.



Experience in sales, customer relationship management, real estate, property services, hospitality, accommodation or a closely related industry is highly desirable.



The ideal candidate will demonstrate:



- Exceptional written English and excellent spoken communication skills.

- Previous experience working with customers in the USA, UK, Ireland or other English-speaking markets.

- Strong commercial awareness and proven ability to convert customer enquiries into sales.

- Excellent judgement when handling objections, hesitant customers and sensitive conversations.

- The ability to build trust and maintain positive customer relationships.

- High levels of organisation, attention to detail and accountability.

- Confidence managing multiple customer conversations simultaneously.

- The ability to work independently without constant supervision.

- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to daily responsibilities.

- Familiarity with CRM systems, WhatsApp Business,
 management and digital business tools.

- An interest in property, hospitality and international accommodation markets.



## AI Proficiency & Independent Thinking



We value professionals who know how to leverage ChatGPT and other AI tools to enhance their existing knowledge, improve research, increase productivity and communicate more effectively.



However, we are specifically looking for someone who can direct AI using their own experience, intelligence and commercial judgement, not someone who allows AI to think or make decisions for them. 



You must be capable of identifying inaccuracies, challenging AI-generated information, recognising inappropriate communication styles and refining responses to suit the customer and situation.



AI should enhance your expertise, not replace it.



## Working Hours



Sunday to Friday, 11:00 AM–7:00 PM Irish time, including a one-hour meal break.



Saturday off.



Candidates must be comfortable working evening and night hours in the Philippines to accommodate Irish business operations.



## Salary & Career Progression



- Monthly base salary of $1,500–$2,000 USD, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.

- Expected starting salary of approximately $1,700 for a suitably qualified candidate.

- Performance-based salary reviews, with opportunities for progression.

- Additional quarterly performance bonuses based on agreed commercial and operational targets.

- Long-term opportunity to develop into a more senior leadership position as the company grows.



## Initial Paid Trial



The successful applicant will undertake an initial "one-week paid assessment period", subject to the agreed employment arrangements.



During this period, we will assess communication standards, independent judgement, accuracy, commercial understanding, initiative and ability to learn our business.



We will provide feedback and communicate the next steps following the initial assessment.



We expect an experienced candidate to become confident handling routine responsibilities within approximately two to three weeks.



## Application Requirements — Please Read Carefully



We have a thorough selection process and are only interested in serious, experienced professionals who meet the requirements above.



Part 1 — Mandatory Loom Video (60–70 Seconds)



Please submit a Loom video introducing yourself and explaining:



- Your relevant sales, customer relationship or property-related experience.

- Why you believe you are suited to a commercially focused operations role.

- One example of how you successfully handled a difficult customer concern or sales objection.



Your face should be visible and your voice clearly audible.



We will assess spoken English, confidence, professionalism, clarity and communication skills.



**Part 2 — Three Written Customer Scenarios**



Please answer each of the following situations as though you were personally responding to the customer.



### Scenario 1 — Sales Ability & Understanding Customer Needs



**Background information:**



Our company helps homeowners advertise their properties for major international sporting events.



We offer two services:



- **Self-Managed — €299:** A one-time listing fee. We advertise the property and pass enquiries to the homeowner, who handles their own bookings. No commission is charged.

- **Fully Managed — €595 upfront:** We handle marketing, guest enquiries, negotiations, guest vetting, contracts and booking arrangements. The upfront fee is refunded if a rental is successfully secured. A 15% commission applies to the final agreed rental amount when a booking is secured.



No rental booking is guaranteed.



**The customer says:**



"Hi, I've got a lovely five-bedroom house and I'm definitely interested in renting it out for the event. I work full-time, though, and I don't really want the hassle of dealing with guests and organising everything myself. Can you explain which option would suit me best and what I'd actually have to pay?"



**Your task:**



Write the
 you would send this customer.



We want to see how you explain the services clearly, identify what the customer actually needs, recommend an appropriate solution and naturally guide them towards the next step.



---



### Scenario 2 — Handling an Unhappy Customer



**The situation:**



A homeowner contacted our company five days ago and sent photographs of their property.



Unfortunately, their enquiry has not yet received a response. You have checked the records and confirmed that the photographs were received, but no further progress has been recorded.



**The customer says:**



"Hi, I sent you photographs of my house nearly a week ago and haven't heard anything back. I'm starting to wonder if your company is even serious about this. I'm interested in renting the property, but I'm not going to waste my time chasing people for updates."



**Your task:**



Write the reply you would send this customer.



We want to see how you handle frustration, take responsibility, restore confidence and keep a potentially valuable customer interested without making promises you cannot guarantee.



---



### Scenario 3 — A Customer Who Is Almost Ready



**The situation:**



A homeowner has already provided photographs and detailed information about their property.



They are interested in proceeding but explain that two bedrooms are not fully prepared and they need to discuss the decision with their partner.



**The customer says:**



"We are definitely interested, but we have a bit more work to do around the house. I'll discuss it with my partner and come back to you."



**Your task:**



Write the reply you would send this customer.



We want to see how you maintain their interest, address their concerns and encourage progress without putting unnecessary pressure on them.



### Important Application Instructions



Please provide your own written response to all three scenarios, exactly as you would communicate with a real customer.



**Do not use ChatGPT or other AI writing tools for this initial assessment.** We want to assess your independent judgement, natural communication style and ability to handle customer situations.



You will have access to AI tools in the actual role, but you must first demonstrate your own professional capabilities.



Applicants must also submit the mandatory **60–70 second Loom introduction video** described in the job advertisement.



We want to evaluate your independent communication skills, understanding of customer behaviour and commercial judgement.



Candidates shortlisted for interview may be asked to complete a further live practical assessment.



Applications that do not include the required Loom video and all three written responses will not be considered.



We are looking for someone dependable, highly capable and committed to taking genuine responsibility for their work.



If you meet these requirements and believe you can make a meaningful contribution to a growing international business, we look forward to reviewing your application.

Codes Health is a well-funded, fast-growing US startup building the modern platform for medical records retrieval. We work with law firms and specialty healthcare providers to get records faster, with zero errors.



BEFORE YOU APPLY

As the first step in our process, we ask all applicants to send a short video recording (2–3 minutes max) answering the following three prompts:



1. Tell us about yourself — what kind of work you've done before, and why you're interested in this role.

2. Tell us about a mistake you made at work. What happened and what did you do about it?

3. Tell us about a time you improved a process at work. What did you change, and what was the result?



Applications without a video answering the 3 questions will not be reviewed.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Providers often require payment before they release records. The Invoice Processing team receives those invoices, checks them, pays them, and moves the request forward. Because payment gates release, your turnaround directly affects how fast we deliver to customers.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Work the invoice queue daily: review provider invoices that arrive by
, fax, and portals (Datavant, ChartSwap, MRO, Verisma, ClearPath) and match each one to the correct request

• Verify every invoice before paying: provider and facility match the request, the amount is reasonable for the record type and volume, it is not a duplicate, and it is within the customer's approved invoice limit

• Pay invoices by credit card, portal, or phone, and route check payments to the right place

• Dispute charges that look wrong (duplicates, overcharges, fees that violate state rules) and follow them through to resolution with the provider

• Get customer approval when an invoice exceeds their limit, with clear notes on what is being charged and why

• Keep clean, complete records of every payment and dispute so finance can reconcile without chasing you

• Flag recurring provider or portal issues and suggest ways to fix or automate them



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Inbound invoices are processed the same day; nothing sits in the queue holding up record release

• Zero duplicate or incorrect payments

• Disputes are documented, tracked, and closed, not left open

• Finance can reconcile your work without asking questions

• You're flagging patterns (repeat overchargers, portal quirks, state billing rules) that help the whole team move faster



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Strong English proficiency — written and spoken (required)

• Comfortable with numbers and careful with money — you double-check before you pay

• Strong attention to detail — you catch duplicates, mismatched amounts, and wrong request IDs before they become problems

• Clear communication — comfortable
ing US customers and provider billing offices about charges and approvals, and calling when needed

• Organized and reliable — able to work a high-volume queue without losing track of anything

• Quick to learn new tools and software workflows (admin dashboards, payment portals)

• Ownership mindset — you follow through until the job is done

• Prior experience in accounts payable, billing, bookkeeping, or medical records invoicing is a plus but not required



WHY CODES HEALTH - Our Website: 

• YC-backed, well-funded, generating revenue and growing fast

• Remote, full-time role

• High-impact position with real visibility into a growing US company

title: Records Processing Specialist (Medical Records QA)
description:
IMPORTANT: VIDEO LINK REQUIRED



Please read this posting in full before submitting.



Codes Health is a well-funded, fast-growing US startup building the modern platform for medical records retrieval. We work with law firms and specialty healthcare providers to get records faster, with zero errors.



BEFORE YOU APPLY

As the first step in our process, we ask all applicants to send a short video recording (2–3 minutes max) answering the following three prompts:



1. Tell us about yourself — what kind of work you've done before, and why you're interested in this role.

2. Tell us about a mistake you made at work. What happened and what did you do about it?

3. Tell us about a time you improved a process at work. What did you change, and what was the result?



Applications without a video answering the 3 questions will not be reviewed.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Records Processing is the quality check between the provider and the customer. When records arrive, you confirm they are complete, correct, and ready to deliver. When something is missing or wrong, you send it back to retrieval with clear instructions. You also review the AI-generated summaries that turn raw records into customer-ready output.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Review records as they arrive and confirm they are complete: correct patient, requested dates of service covered, and every requested record type present (medical, billing, imaging, and others)

• Check that affidavits and certifications are present, signed, and match the records they accompany

• Catch problems before the customer does: wrong patient, missing dates of service, duplicate or unreadable pages, billing records that don't match the medical records

• Return incomplete or incorrect records to retrieval with specific notes on exactly what is missing and what the provider needs to send

• Run and review AI extractions and summaries so the final output is accurate and customer-ready

• Organize, label, and stage documents for final delivery

• Flag providers who repeatedly send incomplete sets and suggest process improvements



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Records move from received to delivery-ready quickly; your queue doesn't age

• Zero customer rework — nothing is delivered with the wrong patient, missing dates, or a bad affidavit

• Your return notes to retrieval are specific enough that the fix is right the first time

• You're spotting patterns and surfacing them, not just clearing the queue



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Strong English proficiency — written and spoken (required)

• Strong attention to detail — comfortable reading through long medical and billing documents and catching what is off

• Able to work carefully at volume without cutting corners

• Clear, specific written communication — your notes tell a teammate exactly what to fix

• Organized and reliable — able to manage a steady queue without letting anything slip

• Quick to learn new tools and software workflows

• Ownership mindset — you follow through until the job is done

• Prior experience in medical records, medical billing or coding, healthcare admin, or legal document review is a plus but not required

title: Client Acquisition/Lead Generation & Appointment Setter
description:
We are looking for one reliable, honest, and proactive person to help book paid consulting calls for a U.S.-based entertainment, music, film, publishing, and business consulting company. This is not a basic VA role and we will not be teaching/training. High lead generation and execution skills are needed.



Your main job is to find leads and bring in paid consulting clients. We are looking to hire quickly and start immediately.



Pay: $150/month base pay + 10% commission on each paid consulting call after the client pays and the payment clears



You will research possible clients, find good leads, send messages, follow up, explain the consulting offer, send the payment link when someone is ready, book the call on the calendar, and remind the client before the call.

Consulting calls may range from $500 to $1,000 depending on the client, service need, and opportunity.



You are not required to close complicated deals. Your job is to find the right people, start conversations, create interest, and get paid calls booked.



This role is best for someone who is:

Honest

Organized

Good at research

Good at messaging people

Comfortable with sales conversations

Able to work without being watched every minute

Focused on results



Daily/weekly tasks may include:

Researching potential clients

Finding artists, creators, business owners, authors, podcasters, filmmakers, and entertainment entrepreneurs

Sending outreach messages

Following up with interested people

Keeping a simple lead tracker updated

Sending payment links

Booking confirmed calls on the calendar

Sending reminders before calls

Reporting what was done each week



To apply:

Please research G-ED UP ENTERTAINMENT and Emerson Geter before applying.



In your application, include the word “water” in the first sentence so we know you read the full post, or we will not see your application.



Also answer these questions:



1. Have you done lead generation before?

2. Have you done appointment setting before?

3. How would you find people who may want entertainment, music, film, publishing, or business consulting?

4. Why should we trust you to bring in paid consulting calls instead of anybody else?

title: Validation QA Specialist (Provider Data Quality)
description:
IMPORTANT: VIDEO LINK REQUIRED



Please read this posting in full before submitting.



Codes Health is a well-funded, fast-growing US startup building the modern platform for medical records retrieval. We work with law firms and specialty healthcare providers to get records faster, with zero errors.



BEFORE YOU APPLY

As the first step in our process, we ask all applicants to send a short video recording (2–3 minutes max) answering the following three prompts:



1. Tell us about yourself — what kind of work you've done before, and why you're interested in this role.

2. Tell us about a mistake you made at work. What happened and what did you do about it?

3. Tell us about a time you improved a process at work. What did you change, and what was the result?



Applications without a video answering the 3 questions will not be reviewed.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Our provider database is the foundation every records request is built on: facility names, records department contacts, fax numbers, submission methods, and billing-company details. Wrong information is worse than no information, because a bad fax number doesn't surface until it has already delayed a live case. This role owns the quality of that database. You'll start by auditing and cleaning what's already there, then move into re-validating providers on a schedule so the data stays trustworthy as we grow.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Audit the existing provider database entry by entry: fix formatting, standardize names and addresses, merge duplicates, and flag fields that are missing or look wrong

• Apply and enforce data standards so every provider record is complete and consistently formatted

• Cross-check entries against provider websites, the NPI registry, and records portals (Datavant, ChartSwap, MRO, and others)

• Re-validate previously verified providers: call records departments to confirm fax, phone, submission method, and third-party billers are still correct, and update the record with a verified timestamp

• Spot-check the validation team's recent work for accuracy and report error patterns back to the team lead

• Review output from AI-assisted lookups against known-good providers and flag where it is wrong

• Track your audit progress and surface data-quality metrics (entries reviewed, errors found, fields corrected)

• Suggest ways to catch bad data earlier and keep the database clean with less manual effort



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• The provider database is clean, consistently formatted, and the validation team trusts it enough to stop using side spreadsheets

• Requests rejected or misrouted because of stale provider data drop toward zero

• Every provider you touch has a verified timestamp and a clear record of what was confirmed and how

• Error patterns you find turn into fixes in the validation process, not just fixes to individual records



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Strong English proficiency — written and spoken (required)

• Meticulous and systematic — you enjoy working through a large dataset carefully, one record at a time, and you don't guess

• Strong data hygiene instincts — you notice inconsistent formatting, duplicates, and fields that don't add up

• Comfortable on the phone — able to call US provider offices to confirm details and navigate phone trees

• Resourceful researcher — you find the right department and contact even when the information isn't obvious

• Organized and reliable — able to track progress across hundreds of records without losing your place

• Quick to learn new tools and software workflows (admin dashboards, spreadsheets, portals)

• Ownership mindset — you follow through until the job is done

• Prior experience in data entry, data QA, healthcare admin, medical records, or provider data management is a plus but not required



WHY CODES HEALTH - Our Website: 

• YC-backed, well-funded, generating revenue and growing fast

• Remote, full-time role

• High-impact position with real visibility into a growing US company

Please read this posting in full before submitting.



Codes Health is a well-funded, fast-growing US startup building the modern platform for medical records retrieval. We work with law firms and specialty healthcare providers to get records faster, with zero errors.



BEFORE YOU APPLY

As the first step in our process, we ask all applicants to send a short video recording (2–3 minutes max) answering the following three prompts:



1. Tell us about yourself — what kind of work you've done before, and why you're interested in this role.
