3. Tell us about a time you improved a process at work. What did you change, and what was the result?



Applications without a video answering the 3 questions will not be reviewed.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Validation sets up the provider side of every records request before retrieval starts. You confirm the right facility, the right records department, accurate contact information, and the correct way to submit, so retrievers start from an accurate setup and records aren't rejected or misrouted downstream. This is a phone-heavy, research-heavy role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Validate providers before requests go out: confirm the correct facility, the records / HIM department, fax and phone numbers, portal availability, and the provider's preferred submission method

• Research providers using their websites, the NPI registry, records portals (Datavant, ChartSwap, MRO, and others), and direct calls to the provider office

• Determine how a request should be split: separate departments, third-party billing companies, radiology or anesthesia billers, copy services

• Identify provider-specific requirements (own authorization forms, prepayment, ID requirements) so requests aren't rejected on arrival

• Keep the provider database accurate, complete, and consistently formatted; re-validate providers whose information has changed

• Respond to escalations from retrievers when a request bounces because of wrong contact info or routing

• Flag patterns and suggest ways to speed up or automate validation



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Retrievers start from an accurate setup; rejections and misroutes caused by bad provider information go to zero

• Validation turnaround is fast and the queue doesn't back up

• Provider records you touch are complete, consistently formatted, and trusted by the team

• You're flagging process improvements, not just completing tasks



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Strong English proficiency — written and spoken (required)

• Excellent phone skills — comfortable making many outbound calls per day to US provider offices, navigating phone trees, and getting to the right person

• Resourceful researcher — you find the right department and contact even when the information isn't obvious

• Strong attention to detail — accurate data entry matters; one wrong fax number can cost weeks

• Organized and reliable — able to work through a daily validation queue without dropping anything

• Quick to learn new tools and software workflows

• Ownership mindset — you follow through until the job is done

• Prior experience in healthcare admin, medical records, provider relations, or outbound calling is a plus but not required

title: WordPress Website & Local SEO Specialist | Part-Time, Long-Term Opportunity
description:
WordPress Website & Local SEO Specialist | Part-Time, Long-Term Opportunity



Company: Hartmann Window Cleaning

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Employment Type: Part-Time, Long-Term

Compensation: $7–$10 USD per hour, based on experience

Trial Period: Initial 30-Day Paid Trial

Schedule: Typically 10–20 hours per week, with additional hours possible during the initial optimization phase



About Our Company



Hartmann Window Cleaning is a growing, faith-based and veteran-owned residential and commercial exterior cleaning company based in Weatherford, Texas, USA.



Our services include window cleaning, soft house washing, pressure washing, gutter cleaning, and solar panel cleaning.



We have built a strong reputation through exceptional customer service, quality workmanship, and a commitment to serving our customers, our team, and our community.



As our business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced WordPress Website & Local SEO Specialist to help improve our website, strengthen our online visibility, and generate more qualified leads.



We are looking for a long-term working relationship with someone who wants to grow alongside our company.



Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced professional who can independently manage, maintain, and optimize our WordPress website while implementing effective SEO strategies.



This is not an entry-level position. We are looking for someone with proven, hands-on experience in WordPress management, technical SEO, on-page SEO, and local search optimization.



The position will begin with a 30-day paid trial period to evaluate technical abilities, communication, reliability, and overall fit.



During the initial phase, additional working hours may be available or required to conduct a comprehensive website evaluation, develop an SEO strategy, and implement priority improvements.



After the initial evaluation and optimization work, we anticipate a regular schedule of approximately 10–20 hours per week for ongoing website maintenance and SEO management.



This position has the potential to develop into a larger part-time or full-time opportunity depending on performance, business growth, and company needs.



Key Responsibilities



1. WordPress Website Management



Maintain, update, and improve our existing WordPress website.



Edit existing pages, images, content, and website layouts.



Create and optimize new service pages and location-specific landing pages.



Troubleshoot technical problems, broken links, and website errors.



Ensure mobile responsiveness, user-friendly navigation, and professional appearance.



Maintain website security, backups, plugins, and updates.



Improve website speed, functionality, and overall user experience.



2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)



Conduct a comprehensive initial SEO audit.



Develop and implement a prioritized SEO improvement strategy.



Perform local keyword research targeting our services and geographic areas.



Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, website content, and internal links.



Identify and resolve technical SEO issues.



Improve website structure, indexing, and crawlability.



Implement relevant schema markup and structured data.



Evaluate competitors and identify opportunities to outperform them.



Stay current with Google SEO best practices and algorithm changes.



3. Local SEO & Search Visibility



Improve organic search visibility in Weatherford, Fort Worth, Aledo, and surrounding Texas communities.



Optimize service pages for relevant local search queries.



Support Google Business Profile optimization and local search consistency.



Identify opportunities for legitimate local citations and relevant backlinks.



Develop strategies to improve visibility in both traditional search engines and AI-powered search results.



Help position our company as a trusted exterior cleaning provider throughout our service areas.



4. Website Analytics & Performance Reporting



Utilize Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.



Monitor website traffic, organic search visibility, keyword performance, and conversions.



Track completed improvements and their results.



Provide regular progress reports with measurable performance indicators.



Recommend additional opportunities to improve website performance and generate leads.



Initial 30-Day Trial & Website Evaluation



During the initial trial period, we expect the selected candidate to:



Conduct an initial review of our website's design, performance, technical health, and SEO.



Identify issues and opportunities for improvement.



Research our competitors and local search market.



Present a prioritized SEO and website optimization strategy.



Recommend an implementation timeline and estimated hours required.



Begin implementing approved priority improvements.



Provide a summary of completed work, findings, and next steps at the end of the trial.



Our goal is to establish a clear strategy and determine whether the candidate is a strong fit for a long-term partnership.



Required Qualifications



Proven professional experience with WordPress and SEO.



Strong background in on-page, technical, and local SEO.



Demonstrated ability to improve website search visibility and organic performance.



Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.



Proficiency with WordPress SEO tools such as Rank Math or Yoast.



Experience troubleshooting WordPress website issues.

title: Senior Google Ads Performance & Growth Manager
description:
## About 




 is a U.S.-based e-commerce retailer specializing in ink cartridges, toner cartridges, and printer supplies.



We operate a large product catalog across multiple printer brands and models, serving customers through our Shopify store.



Our Google Ads program currently represents approximately **$70,000–$75,000 in monthly advertising spend**, with around **1,500 advertised products** across Performance Max, Google Shopping, and Search campaigns.



We have developed an internal analytics platform that consolidates Google Ads performance with Shopify sales, product-level trends, inventory, pricing, margins, and listing-quality information.



We are looking for a highly experienced Google Ads professional who can take ownership of advertising performance, continuously improve profitability, and drive sustainable revenue growth.



## The Role



This is not a basic PPC campaign management position.



We are seeking someone who understands how to operate and optimize a sophisticated Google Ads program for a catalog-heavy e-commerce business.



The ideal candidate can analyze performance at both the campaign and individual product level, identify opportunities, diagnose performance declines, and implement strategies that increase profitable sales.



You will have access to detailed product-level data and are expected to turn that information into measurable improvements.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Google Ads Strategy & Campaign Management



- Take ownership of our Google Ads program, including Performance Max, Standard Shopping, Search, and remarketing where applicable.

- Continuously evaluate campaign structure, segmentation, bidding strategies, budgets, and targeting.

- Optimize budget allocation across campaigns, product categories, brands, and individual products.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions.

- Evaluate when products should be managed through Performance Max versus Standard Shopping or Search.

- Manage negative keywords, search-term relevance, brand versus non-brand traffic, and campaign exclusions where supported.

- Develop controlled experiments to improve campaign performance.

- Monitor Google Ads platform changes and apply relevant improvements.



### 2. Product-Level Performance Optimization



Our catalog includes approximately 1,500 advertised products, each with different demand patterns, competition, pricing, and profitability.



Responsibilities include:



- Analyze impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, conversion value, and ROAS at the product level.

- Identify high-potential products that are receiving insufficient advertising exposure.

- Identify products consuming advertising spend without generating adequate returns.

- Recommend product segmentation based on sales velocity, margin, profitability, demand, and competitive position.

- Identify products that should receive increased investment, reduced investment, or different advertising strategies.

- Investigate products experiencing significant traffic or sales declines.

- Identify opportunities to increase advertising coverage across our catalog.



### 3. Profitability & Revenue Growth



Our objective is not simply to increase traffic or achieve a high reported ROAS. We want to maximize profitable growth.



You will:



- Optimize advertising investment based on product economics, not just Google-reported conversion value.

- Work with product margins, pricing, and Shopify sales data to evaluate advertising profitability.

- Identify opportunities to grow revenue while maintaining sustainable acquisition costs.

- Evaluate incremental revenue opportunities and diminishing returns from advertising spend.

- Recommend budget increases where the expected financial return justifies additional investment.

- Reduce inefficient spending without unnecessarily sacrificing profitable sales volume.



### 4. Sales Decline Investigation & Recovery



We have an internal analytics platform that combines Google Ads and Shopify performance data.



You will be expected to use this information to:



- Identify products experiencing meaningful sales declines.

- Determine whether declines are associated with reduced advertising exposure, lower CTR, rising CPC, conversion deterioration, campaign changes, or other factors.

- Distinguish advertising problems from pricing, inventory, product-page, or market-demand issues.

- Develop and execute recovery plans for advertising-related problems.

- Collaborate with our Shopify Listing Manager and Operations team on issues outside Google Ads.

- Measure whether corrective actions successfully recover sales and profitability.



### 5. Google Shopping Feed & Merchant Center Optimization



- Monitor Google Merchant Center product eligibility, disapprovals, and warnings.

- Identify and resolve feed-related issues in coordination with the Shopify team.

- Recommend improvements to product titles, descriptions, product types, Google product categories, and feed attributes.

- Improve product visibility and relevance for high-intent searches.

- Evaluate the effectiveness of product segmentation and custom labels.

- Ensure important products are appropriately represented in Google Shopping.

- Coordinate product data improvements without disrupting existing Shopify catalog processes.



### 6. Search Campaign Optimization



- Analyze search-term performance and identify wasted spending.

- Expand high-intent keyword coverage.

- Optimize match types, negative keywords, bidding strategies, and ad copy.

- Evaluate Dynamic Search Ads and other Search campaign structures.

- Separate branded and non-branded performance where appropriate.

- Identify search opportunities for printer models, cartridge numbers, product compatibility, and related customer intent.

- Improve landing-page relevance in collaboration with the Shopify team.



### 7. Conversion Tracking & Measurement



- Monitor Google Ads conversion tracking accuracy and consistency.

- Understand Google Ads attribution, conversion lag, and differences between Google Ads and Shopify reporting.

- Identify potential tracking problems, duplicate conversions, or misleading conversion metrics.

- Validate that advertising decisions are based on reliable data.

- Recommend measurement improvements and structured experiments to evaluate incremental performance.



### 8. Continuous Testing & Growth Opportunities



We expect proactive experimentation rather than routine campaign maintenance.



Examples include:



- Testing alternative Performance Max campaign structures.

- Testing product segmentation by profitability or sales velocity.

- Testing bidding strategies and target ROAS levels.

- Identifying underserved printer brands, cartridge families, or customer search intents.

- Testing different advertising approaches for high-margin products.

- Identifying opportunities to increase average order value through appropriate product and bundle promotion.

- Expanding advertising coverage to newly added products.



Each meaningful experiment should have a clear hypothesis, success criteria, and measurable results.



## Performance Expectations



Success will be measured primarily through:



| KPI | Objective |

|---|---|

| Advertising profitability | Improve contribution profit after advertising costs |

| Google Ads ROAS | Improve efficiency without sacrificing profitable growth |

| Revenue growth | Increase profitable Shopify sales |

| Product coverage | Improve advertising exposure for commercially attractive products |

| Wasted ad spend | Identify and reduce unproductive spending |

| Sales recovery | Recover declining products where advertising is a contributing factor |

| Merchant Center health | Minimize unresolved product eligibility issues |

| Experimentation | Consistently test and implement measurable improvements |



We value business outcomes over activity metrics.



## Reporting & Accountability



The manager will be expected to:



**Daily**

- Monitor campaign performance and unusual changes.

- Investigate major spend, traffic, and conversion anomalies.

- Address urgent product eligibility or campaign issues.



**Weekly**

- Review campaign and product-level performance.

- Identify growth and recovery opportunities.

- Recommend and execute optimization actions.

- Report meaningful changes, actions taken, and results.

- Review ongoing experiments.



**Monthly**

- Evaluate overall advertising profitability.

- Review campaign structure and budget allocation.

- Present a growth and optimization plan.

- Identify opportunities to expand profitable revenue.

- Report the financial impact of implemented changes.



Our internal portal provides much of the required data, so the emphasis should be on analysis, decisions, and execution—not manually assembling spreadsheets.



## Required Qualifications



- At least 5 years of hands-on Google Ads experience, with substantial recent e-commerce experience.

- Demonstrated responsibility for Google Ads accounts spending **$50,000+ per month**.

- Advanced expertise in Performance Max, Google Shopping, and Search campaigns.

- Strong knowledge of Google Merchant Center and product feed optimization.

- Experience managing large product catalogs with hundreds or thousands of SKUs.

- Deep understanding of ROAS, CPA, conversion tracking, attribution, and advertising profitability.

- Strong analytical skills and ability to diagnose performance problems.

- Experience designing and evaluating advertising experiments.

- Ability to make independent optimization decisions and explain the business rationale.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Comfortable working with custom analytics dashboards and cross-functional teams.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience in ink, toner, printer supplies, electronics accessories, or similar catalog-heavy retail categories.

- Experience with Shopify and product-feed management tools.

- Experience optimizing campaigns using product-level gross margins or contribution margins.

- Experience with Google Ads scripts, automation, or API-based reporting.

- Familiarity with GA4 and Google Tag Manager.

- Experience managing advertising programs with significant Performance Max spend.



## Who Will Succeed in This Role



We are looking for someone who:



- Thinks like a business owner, not just a campaign operator.

- Understands the difference between high ROAS and profitable incremental growth.

- Can independently identify opportunities instead of waiting for instructions.

- Is comfortable investigating problems at the individual product level.

- Can challenge existing campaign structures using data and sound judgment.

- Works collaboratively with Shopify, inventory, and operations teams.

- Is disciplined about testing, measurement, and documenting results.



## Application Requirements



Please provide:



1. A summary of your Google Ads experience, including the largest monthly budget you have personally managed.

2. Examples of e-commerce accounts you have managed, including approximate catalog size and campaign types.

3. Two specific examples where you materially improved Google Ads performance, including the starting problem, actions taken, and measurable outcomes.

4. Your experience with Performance Max versus Standard Shopping campaign strategies.

5. Your experience using product-level profitability or margin data to guide advertising decisions.

6. Your expected monthly compensation in USD.

7. Your availability and preferred working hours.



**Important:** We are interested in your individual hands-on expertise, not agency presentations or generic claims of Google Ads certification.



Candidates shortlisted for interviews may be asked to complete a practical case study based on anonymized campaign performance data.

title: Maintenance coordinator
description:
Real Property Management Sunshine City is seeking an experienced Senior Maintenance Coordinator to manage all maintenance operations across a portfolio of approximately 300 single-family and small multifamily residential units in Pinellas County, Florida.



The Senior Maintenance Coordinator is responsible for the complete work order lifecycle, from tenant intake through vendor assignment, completion, invoice review, and owner billing. This position also carries responsibility for vendor sourcing, cost control, and some after-hours emergency response.



This is a senior-level position. Candidates must have prior experience performing this function at a United States residential property management company. Training will not be provided on core maintenance coordination fundamentals, repair cost estimating, or property management operations.



---



Key Responsibilities



**Work Order Management**

- Manage the full work order lifecycle in AppFolio, including intake, triage, vendor assignment, scheduling, follow-up, completion verification, and closeout

- Triage all inbound maintenance requests and correctly classify emergency, urgent, and routine items in accordance with company standards and Florida habitability requirements

- Maintain accurate and complete documentation, including photographs, vendor notes, and communication records, within AppFolio

- Provide status updates to tenants, owners, and internal staff throughout the repair process



**Vendor Management**

- Assign work to appropriate vendors based on trade, location, availability, urgency, and cost

- Source, qualify, and onboard new vendors across plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, appliance repair, general handyman, and turnover trades

- Verify and maintain current vendor licensing, insurance certificates, and W-9 documentation

- Negotiate pricing and service level expectations with vendors and maintain preferred-vendor relationships



**Cost Control and Billing**

- Review all vendor invoices against approved scopes of work and identify overbilling, duplicate charges, and unauthorized scope expansion prior to owner billing

- Obtain and evaluate competitive bids on repairs exceeding established thresholds

- Communicate with property owners regarding repairs approaching or exceeding spending authority, including written recommendations supported by cost documentation

- Monitor maintenance spend by property and report variances to the Director of Operations



**Turnover Coordination**

- Coordinate make-ready and unit turnover work against leasing timelines to minimize vacancy loss

- Schedule and oversee inspections, cleaning, painting, flooring, and repair work associated with tenant turnover

- Coordinate with the in-house maintenance technician on scope allocation between internal and vendor-performed work



**Emergency Response**

- Participate in rotating after-hours and weekend emergency on-call coverage

- Respond to and coordinate emergency repairs including water intrusion, HVAC failure, electrical hazards, and storm-related damage



---



Required Qualifications



- Minimum of five (5) years of maintenance coordination experience at a United States residential property management company. Applicants without this experience will not be considered.

- Demonstrated working proficiency in AppFolio Property Manager, including work orders, service requests, vendor records, and owner billing functions

- Demonstrated knowledge of current market pricing for plumbing, HVAC, electrical, and general handyman work, with the ability to evaluate quotes and invoices for reasonableness without external reference

- Demonstrated experience sourcing, vetting, and onboarding new trade vendors

- Proven ability to manage high inbound call volume in a fast-paced environment while maintaining professional communication with tenants, owners, and vendors

- Availability for occasional after-hours and weekend work, including participation in emergency on-call rotation

- Strong written communication skills sufficient for owner correspondence and documentation of maintenance decisions



---

Preferred Qualifications



- Direc background in plumbing, HVAC, or general construction

- Experience within a property management platform or multi-owner portfolio reporting environment



## Work Schedule



Monday through Friday, [8:30 AM to 5:00 PM EST], on-site. Participation in a rotating after-hours and weekend emergency on-call schedule is required. On-call periods are compensated by additional pay.

title: Accounts Payable Coordinator
description:
Position Summary:

The Accounts Payable Coordinator provides financial and administrative support through the accurate and timely processing of accounts payable transactions. Reviews, codes, and processes invoices for payment, maintains vendor records, reconciles accounts and expenses, and ensures compliance with company policies and financial procedures. Tracks expenditures and assists with reporting to support effective financial management.



Candidate must be available to work between the hours of 08:00-16:30 EST/EDT (Eastern Standard
 Daylight Time).



Key Responsibilities:

• Maintain accounts payable records in QuickBooks Online

• Track payments and expenses including vendor invoices, purchase orders, and operating expenses of the business

• Receive, review, verify, and process vendor invoices

• Maintain vendor accounts for timely payments and compliance with internal controls

• Reconciliation of payments through verification, rechecking, auditing, and other tools to maintain accurate financial 

        records

• Ensure timely preparation of vendor invoices and check preparations

• Communicate with suppliers, vendors, and creditors about their payment schedules, outstanding credit balances, and 

        other requirements

• Provide essential support to the senior management by providing accurate financial data

• Assist and supports in tax payments and audit preparations

• Prepares financial reports as needed



Required Qualifications:

•  High school diploma

• Associate degree in accounting preferred or strong professional background of 2+ years accounts payable experience



Required Skills & Competencies:

•     Minimum of 2 years of experience using QuickBooks Online.

•     Demonstrated ability to accurately calculate, post, reconcile, and maintain accounting records and financial transactions.

•     Strong customer service skills with the ability to build positive relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders.

•     Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

•     Exceptional organizational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

•     Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and take initiative.

•     Strong time management skills with the ability to prioritize workload and meet deadlines.

•     Proven ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

•     Proficiency in problem-solving and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.

•     Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and exercising sound judgment when handling financial information. 



Performance Expectations:

Success in this role is measured by:

•     Process invoices accurately and on time while maintaining compliance with company policies and procedures.

•     Ensure vendors are paid according to payment terms, minimizing late fees and maintaining positive supplier 

      relationships.

•    Reconcile accounts and expenses accurately, promptly resolving discrepancies and outstanding issues.

•    Maintain organized and complete financial records with a high degree of attention to detail.

•    Meet month-end and year-end closing deadlines by providing accurate accounts payable data and reporting.

•    Identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and support strong financial controls.

•    Deliver responsive and professional service to internal departments and external vendors.

title: Full-Time YouTube Video Editor – Sleep Channel | Character Animation | $600/Month
description:
Full-Time YouTube Video Editor – Sleep Channel | Character Animation | $600/Month



Hey!



I’m looking for a reliable video editor for a long-term, full-time position on my YouTube sleep channel.



You’ll edit 3 videos per week, each over one hour long. The salary is $600 per month.



The video format



The videos will feature a character on the left side of the screen, with relevant clips, images, or other visuals on the right.



You must be able to create slow, subtle character animations—not simply place a static character next to footage. Movements such as gentle blinking, slight head movements, and relaxed gestures should feel natural and calming. Animation loops are welcome, provided they are seamless and do not look distracting or noticeably repetitive.



The character and footage should work together in a clean, consistent layout, with visuals that match the narration.



Your responsibilities



- Edit 3 videos per week, each over one hour long.

- Animate the character with slow, subtle movements.

- Source suitable clips, photos, background music, and other visual assets that we have permission to use.

- Choose visuals that accurately support the script.

- Maintain consistent pacing, audio levels, and visual style throughout each video.

- Apply feedback and meet agreed deadlines.



I will provide the script. You won’t need to research or write the topic, but you must understand the narration well enough to select appropriate footage.



The style



These videos should create a calm, relaxing experience that helps viewers fall asleep:



- Slow-paced visuals and smooth transitions.

- Gentle character movements.

- Soft, consistent audio and subtle background music.

- No sudden cuts, loud sounds, flashing visuals, or distracting effects.



Who I’m looking for



- Experience editing YouTube videos, ideally sleep, relaxation, or long-form educational content.

- The ability to create simple 2D character animation is essential.

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable editing and animation software.

- Strong English comprehension.

- Good communication, attention to detail, and the ability to follow feedback.

- Full-time availability and the capacity to deliver consistently.



How to apply



Start your proposal with your favorite animal so I know you’ve read the full post.



Please include:



1. Relevant editing samples, especially sleep or long-form videos.

2. At least one example of character animation you personally created, with a brief explanation of your contribution.

3. The software you use for editing and animation.

4. Confirmation that you’re comfortable with $600 per month for 3 videos per week, each over one hour long.

5. Your availability and earliest start date.



I’m looking for someone who can become a dependable, long-term part of the channel. I look forward to seeing your work!

title: AUTO CAD DRAFTER
description:

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Commercial Furniture Drafter to join our growing team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between design concepts and manufacturing by creating precise, production-ready shop drawings for custom commercial furniture and cabinetry projects.



You will work closely with our designers, project managers, and production teams to ensure every drawing accurately reflects client specifications while remaining fully manufacturable.



Key Responsibilities

Drafting & Detailing: Create highly accurate shop drawings and production-ready plans for commercial furniture and custom millwork projects.



Design Translation: Interpret design concepts, client specifications, and architectural sketches into precise technical drawings.



Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with designers, project managers, and fabrication teams to ensure structural integrity, proper material selection, and manufacturability.



Revisions & Updates: Efficiently revise, update, and maintain control over drawing packages based on client feedback and production adjustments.



Compliance & Standards: Ensure all technical drawings strictly comply with internal manufacturing standards and production guidelines.



File Management: Maintain organized project files, revision histories, and technical documentation.



Qualifications (Must-Haves)

Millwork Experience: Proven hands-on drafting experience with millwork, custom cabinetry, or architectural woodworking is strictly required.



CAD Proficiency: Strong expertise in CAD software for detailed 2D/3D drafting and drafting standards.



Construction Knowledge: In-depth understanding of commercial furniture construction methods, material properties, and manufacturing processes.



Precision & Detail: Exceptional attention to detail, spatial awareness, and technical problem-solving skills.



Project Management: Ability to manage multiple active project deadlines simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.



Communication: Clear verbal and written communication skills for cross-team coordination.



Preferred Qualifications

Mozaik Software: Hands-on experience with Mozaik software is a strong plus (not strictly required, but highly preferred).



Shop Environment Experience: Background working directly within a commercial furniture or millwork manufacturing facility.



Woodworking Background: Familiarity with CNC machinery setup, joinery methods, and hardware integration.



Why Join Us?

100% Remote Flexibility: Work full-time from the comfort of your home office.



High-Impact Work: Draft unique, high-end custom commercial furniture projects.



Collaborative Team: Work alongside dedicated professionals who value craftsmanship and design accuracy.



Long-Term Growth: Opportunity for career advancement as our production scale grows.



How to Apply

Submit your resume along with a portfolio or samples of past millwork/furniture shop drawings demonstrating your CAD drafting capabilities.

title: Business Development & Sales Manager – B2B Technology / AI / Voice
description:
We are hiring an experienced Business Development & Sales Manager to build new business for Cloudspire, our next-generation AI and cloud communications platform.



This is a * senior * , hands-on sales role for someone who knows how to create opportunities rather than simply work leads that are handed to them.



We are looking for a true hunter: someone who can identify markets, find decision-makers, determine how to reach them, start conversations, build relationships, demonstrate our products, follow up consistently, and turn opportunities into recurring revenue.



### Compensation



This position includes a **$1,250 USD monthly base salary plus uncapped commission**.



In addition to your base salary, you will earn **5% of qualifying recurring revenue from new customers you generate, paid monthly for the first 12 months of each customer relationship.**



Successful sales therefore continue generating commission every month as the customer continues paying. There is no commission cap. This can create potentially life-changing income potential.



### What You Will Do



You will be responsible for developing new business for Cloudspire Voice, Cloudspire AI, and related technology services.



Responsibilities include:



- Identify industries, businesses, and decision-makers that are strong prospects for our products

- Build your own prospecting strategy rather than waiting for leads to be assigned

- Research companies and identify the correct people to contact

- Use LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator extensively for prospecting and relationship development

- Conduct outbound prospecting by telephone,
, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, and other appropriate channels

- Develop referral relationships, channel partnerships, technology partnerships, and other sources of recurring business

- Generate qualified sales opportunities from the ground up

- Respond professionally and quickly to inbound opportunities

- Conduct discovery calls with prospective customers

- Learn Cloudspire Voice and Cloudspire AI well enough to conduct professional product demonstrations

- Explain AI agents, business communications, voice, messaging, automation, integrations, and related technology in clear business terms

- Follow up consistently with prospects throughout the sales cycle

- Build long-term relationships rather than relying only on one-time cold outreach

- Maintain all prospects, communications, opportunities, notes, follow-up dates, and pipeline stages accurately in our CRM

- Develop and continuously maintain a healthy sales pipeline

- Assist with proposals and statements of work as your knowledge of our products develops

- Track prospecting activity, meetings, demonstrations, pipeline value, conversions, and closed business

- Identify new vertical markets and sales opportunities

- Provide feedback about objections, competitive products, pricing, customer needs, and market trends

- Take ownership of opportunities from initial prospecting through discovery, demonstration, proposal, follow-up, and closing



### This Is Not Just an Appointment-Setting Job



We are not looking for someone whose only responsibility is making calls from a prepared list and scheduling meetings for someone else.



You should be capable of asking:



- Who should we be selling to?

- Which industries have the strongest need for our products?

- Who are the decision-makers?

- How do we reach them?

- What message will get their attention?

- What partnerships could introduce us to hundreds of potential customers?

- How do we turn an initial conversation into a qualified opportunity?

- What follow-up will move that opportunity forward?



You will have considerable freedom to develop answers to those questions and work directly with company leadership to refine our sales strategy.



### Marketing & Growth



This is primarily a business development and sales position, but broader growth and marketing experience is a significant advantage.



Experience with any of the following is valuable:



- LinkedIn marketing and organic outreach

-
 campaigns and sequencing

- Lead databases and prospect intelligence tools

- CRM automation

- Referral and channel marketing

- Industry associations and networking

- Developing sales messaging and offers

- Landing pages and conversion strategy

- Digital advertising or PPC

- Using AI tools for prospect research, outreach, sales preparation, and follow-up



You will not be expected to personally manage every aspect of digital marketing. Company leadership handles much of our AI-driven marketing and technical campaign work. We want someone who can connect those efforts to actual conversations, relationships, pipeline, and revenue.



### Who We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate has significant B2B business development or technology sales experience and a demonstrated ability to generate new opportunities independently.



Experience selling to U.S. businesses is strongly preferred.



Background in any of the following is particularly valuable:



- Artificial intelligence

- Business telecommunications

- VoIP

- UCaaS

- Cloud communications

- SaaS

- Managed IT services

- MSP services

- Cloud technology

- Cybersecurity

- Other recurring-revenue B2B technology



Excellent spoken and written English is essential. You will regularly speak with U.S.-based business owners, executives, managers, and technology professionals by telephone and video.



You must be comfortable conducting discovery calls and eventually presenting live Cloudspire product demonstrations after receiving training.



Your responsibilities will be end-to-end, A to Z:



- Building partnerships

- Procuring leads

- Nurturing potential leads

- Providing product demos

- Closing deals

- Continued non-technical account management for acquired customers



We value initiative, persistence, professionalism, organization, attention to detail, creativity, and measurable results.



### Opportunity



You will work directly with company leadership and have an opportunity to help develop our sales process rather than simply inherit an established script.



As Cloudspire grows, this position has significant potential to grow into sales leadership, including helping build and eventually manage a larger business development organization.



### Schedule



This is a full-time, fully remote position supporting the U.S. market.



Monday through Friday  

8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time - 



Flexibility is available, however, reliable availability during U.S. business hours is required.

title: Skilled SEO Specialist - 69K Per Month - USA Websites (Full Time)
description:
Read this before you apply:



1. We are hiring an SEO specialist who can show websites they personally helped rank. Because knowing the terminology, listing tools, or explaining what you would do is not enough. We need evidence of what you have already done.



2. Read the “How To Apply” and follow instructions - Applications without both the GSC screenshots and keyword lists will not be shortlisted. Please read this entire post, especially the “How to Apply”, before submitting.



Why an experienced SEO specialist should choose us:



1. Above Average Monthly Salary



Bring your proven SEO experience to a full-time role paying approximately ₱69,000 per month (US$1,100), with the flexibility of working remotely.



2. Deliver Results and Grow Your Salary



Your starting salary does not have to be your ceiling. Strong performers have opportunities for salary raises, promotions, bonuses, and performance-based incentives as their results and responsibilities grow.



3. Build Your Career Across Multiple US Businesses



Expand your track record across healthcare, construction, real estate, consulting, and other industries. Build experience managing different markets and business models — valuable preparation for larger SEO and leadership roles.



4. Focus on SEO With Writers and Developers Behind You



You will have access to an in-house team that can help turn your recommendations into published content and website improvements. Spend more of your time driving results, with support for the work needed to achieve them.



5. Have a Real Say in Strategy



Put your experience and judgment to work. You will have room to recommend priorities, test ideas, and make decisions without being micromanaged. We want someone whose expertise helps shape the direction.



6. Work Remotely Without Putting Career Growth on Hold



Work from anywhere in the Philippines while handling US accounts and collaborating with an established digital team. Build your career without relocating or commuting to an office.



MAIN REQUIREMENTS



1. Strong Content Marketing Skills



We believe that high-quality content accounts for a significant portion of SEO success. The right candidate must understand how to plan and create content that satisfies search intent, demonstrates genuine expertise, and performs well in both Google Search and AI-powered search engines. You do not need to be a full-time writer, and you will have access to our in-house content team.



We are not looking for someone who simply assigns keywords to writers. You must be capable of directing the complete content strategy and ensuring that every page has a clear purpose and a realistic opportunity to rank.



2. Proven Top 3 Position in Google



You must provide verifiable evidence that you have personally helped websites rank within the top 3 organic Google positions for at least 15–20 meaningful and competitive keywords. We regularly receive applications from candidates who can discuss SEO concepts but cannot demonstrate significant ranking results. For this role, actual results are essential.



Your evidence should include:

• Google Search Console screenshots showing improvements in clicks and impressions

• A list of websites you directly optimized

• At least 15–20 keywords that reached Google’s top three organic positions

• The approximate ranking period or timeline

• Your specific responsibilities and the actions you personally implemented

• Supporting screenshots or third-party ranking reports, when available



Important Disclaimer Regarding Results:



The results you submit must be primarily attributable to your own strategy and execution. Please do not present the overall success of a large SEO team if you were only a minor contributor or handled a limited portion of the work.



3. Strong Analytical and Problem-Solving Ability



SEO presents different challenges, and the same strategy will not work in every situation. We need someone who can diagnose problems, identify likely causes, prioritize the right actions, and adjust the strategy based on evidence.

We are not looking for someone who relies on generic SEO checklists. You must be able to investigate each situation using data, form a clear diagnosis, recommend a practical solution, and measure whether your strategy is working.



4. Ownership and Ability to Work Independently



We do not want to micromanage the person in this role. You will be given clear business objectives, target websites, and performance expectations. We are looking for a mature, proactive professional who can work with minimal supervision, take responsibility for decisions, communicate problems early, and remain accountable for results.

If progress slows down, you should investigate why and recommend the next course of action - not wait for someone to tell you what to do.



HOW TO APPLY



 your application to 



Please include all of the following:



1. Your updated resume



2.Google Search Console screenshots for the websites you personally optimized, showing graph in organic clicks and impressions



3. For each website you optimized in the past, give a list of at least 15–20 keywords you personally helped rank within the top 3 organic positions on Google



Please do not submit results that primarily came from the work of a larger team unless you clearly disclose your individual contribution.



Applications without verifiable SEO results may not be considered.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a practical SEO assessment before proceeding to the interview stage.

About Us



Porcupine Paint is a growing residential and commercial painting company based in Denver, Colorado.



We're bringing our Meta advertising management in-house and looking for an experienced, analytical Meta Ads specialist to help us continuously improve our
 and Instagram advertising performance.



We already have the ability to create campaigns, film advertisements, and produce video content. What we're looking for is someone who excels at analyzing campaign performance, identifying opportunities, and recommending data-driven optimizations.



You'll work directly with the business owner, who manages marketing strategy, and collaborate with our existing video editor.



This role is primarily focused on performance analysis and ongoing optimization.



Your Responsibilities



-Campaign creation, Monitoring & Optimization

-Review Meta advertising performance at least twice per week.

-Identify winning and underperforming campaigns, ad sets, and advertisements.

-Monitor key performance indicators and identify trends or potential issues.

-Recommend which advertisements to scale, pause, or modify.

-Identify creative fatigue, declining performance, and opportunities to improve results.

-Implement approved optimizations when needed.



KPI Analysis & Reporting



-Analyze cost per lead (CPL), cost per booked estimate, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and other relevant KPIs.

-Look beyond Meta Ads Manager to understand lead quality and actual business results.

-Help identify which advertisements are generating qualified leads rather than simply inexpensive leads.

-Provide a concise weekly performance report with actionable recommendations.

-Explain what the data means and what specific changes should be made.



Creative Strategy & Continuous Improvement



-Analyze advertising creative to determine which hooks, messaging, offers, and formats perform best.

-Recommend new creative concepts and variations based on campaign performance.

-Work with the business owner and video editor to develop new advertising tests.

-Help establish a consistent testing and optimization process.



Proactive Communication



-Communicate directly with the business owner on a weekly basis.

-Proactively flag performance issues and opportunities.

-Follow up on recommended changes to ensure campaigns are continuously improving.

-Take ownership of the optimization process without needing constant reminders.



What We're Looking For



Required Qualifications



-Proven hands-on experience managing and optimizing Meta Ads campaigns.

-Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager and lead-generation advertising.

-Demonstrated ability to analyze campaign KPIs and make data-driven recommendations.

-Experience with A/B testing, creative performance analysis, and campaign optimization.

-Ability to explain advertising performance clearly and concisely.

-Strong written English communication skills.

-Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive.

-Comfortable working independently and directly with a business owner.



Strongly Preferred



-Experience managing Meta Ads for local home-service businesses such as painting, roofing, HVAC, remodeling, landscaping, or similar industries.

-Experience tracking leads beyond Meta, including booked appointments, closed sales, and customer acquisition costs.

-Familiarity with CRM systems and lead attribution.

-Experience optimizing campaigns with monthly advertising budgets of $3,000–$5,000.



What You Won't Be Responsible For



-Video editing or graphic design.

-Organic social media management.

-Filming or producing advertising content.

-Building every advertising campaign from scratch.

-Managing our entire marketing strategy.



Our owner handles campaign strategy and content creation, and we already have a dedicated video editor.



Your primary responsibility is to analyze what's happening and help us make better advertising decisions.



What Success Looks Like



-We're looking for someone who proactively comes to us each week and says:



"Here's what's working, here's what's not working, here's what the numbers are telling us, and here's what I recommend we do next."



-We want someone who enjoys digging into data, identifying patterns, testing hypotheses, and continually improving results.



Our goal is to establish a consistent optimization process so that our advertising campaigns are never left running without regular analysis and improvement.



Compensation & Schedule



$10 USD per hour.



Approximately 5 hours per week ($50/week).



Flexible working hours.



Weekly performance updates and communication required.



Initial 30-day paid trial.



Long-term opportunity for the right candidate, with potential for additional hours as our advertising operations grow.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



Home Services Experience: Have you managed Meta advertising for local home-service businesses? Which industries?



Campaign Results: Share an example of a lead-generation campaign you optimized. Include the monthly ad spend, KPIs you monitored, changes you made, and measurable results.



KPI Analysis: Which five metrics do you consider most important when evaluating a local home-service lead-generation campaign, and why?



Optimization Process: If you were managing a Meta account spending $100/day, what would your weekly optimization process look like?



Creative Analysis: How do you determine when an advertisement needs new creative versus adjustments to targeting, budget, or campaign structure?



Availability: Are you comfortable working approximately 5 hours per week at $10 USD/hour?



Please include screenshots, anonymized reports, or case studies demonstrating your experience whenever possible.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words "PURPLE PORCUPINE" so we know you've read the entire job posting.



We are looking to hire an individual specialist, not an agency.



If you enjoy analyzing advertising performance, finding opportunities others miss, and working directly with a business owner to improve results, we'd love to hear from you.

- Use NinjaOne RMM for endpoint monitoring, management, remote access, patching, and support

- Manage SentinelOne endpoint security, including reviewing alerts and assisting with threat mitigation

- Troubleshoot networking issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routers, firewalls, Wi-Fi, and general connectivity

- Work extensively within our ticketing system while following documented procedures, priorities, escalation requirements, and service standards

- Document troubleshooting, changes, customer communications, and resolutions thoroughly and accurately



### VoIP & Cloud Communications



Telecommunications is an increasingly important part of this position. You will support our Cloudspire Voice platform and work with business-class VoIP systems, including:



- VoIP and SIP troubleshooting

- Cloud PBX administration

- Phone provisioning and configuration

- Extensions, users, hunt groups, auto attendants, call queues, and call routing

- Troubleshooting call quality, registration, connectivity, and signaling issues

- Number provisioning and related telecom support

- Supporting physical phones, softphones, and mobile applications

- Working directly with customers to diagnose and resolve communications problems



Strong prior VoIP, SIP, PBX, UCaaS, or telecommunications experience will be highly valued.



### AI & Emerging Technology



Cloudspire AI is one of the fastest-growing areas of our business. Prior AI experience is **not required**, but it is a significant advantage.



The technician will have an opportunity to learn and work with:



- AI voice agents

- AI-powered customer service and communications

- Agent prompting and configuration

- Call flows and automation

- API integrations

- Troubleshooting AI conversations and behaviors

- Connecting AI agents with business systems and communications platforms



We are looking for someone who is interested in learning these technologies rather than someone who wants to remain exclusively in traditional desktop support.



### Customer Service & Communication



Customer satisfaction is extremely important to us.



You will communicate directly with U.S.-based customers by telephone,
, tickets, and remote support sessions throughout the workday. You must be professional, patient, courteous, and confident speaking with customers.



*** Excellent spoken and written English is required. ***



Attention to detail is also critical. Tickets must be documented correctly, instructions must be followed carefully, configurations must be verified, and customer requests must be completed accurately.



### Additional Skills That Can Create Opportunity



We are a small technology company, so people who bring skills beyond their primary role can have opportunities to contribute in other areas.



Experience or interest in any of the following would be considered a significant bonus:



- Technology sales or pre-sales

- Conducting product demonstrations

- Customer relationship management

- Business development

- Lead generation

- Digital marketing

- Social media or LinkedIn outreach

- Helping identify additional services that would benefit an existing customer



These skills are **not requirements for the position**. Technical ability and customer support come first. However, someone who combines strong technical knowledge with communication, business, or sales ability could become especially valuable as the company grows.



### The Person We Are Looking For



We want an experienced technician who can investigate a problem rather than immediately escalate it.



The right person should be comfortable moving between a Windows computer problem, a Microsoft 365 issue, a network problem, a VoIP call-routing issue, and a Cloudspire configuration during the same day.



You should be:



- Technically experienced and naturally curious

- Strong at troubleshooting and problem solving

- Comfortable working independently

- Extremely attentive to detail

- Organized with tickets and documentation

- Dependable and consistent

- Professional with customers

- Interested in VoIP, communications, cloud technology, and AI

- Willing to continue learning as our products and technology evolve



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and who can become an important member of our technical team.



### Schedule



This is a full-time, fully remote position supporting U.S.-based customers.



**Monday through Friday**  

**8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time**



Reliable attendance and availability during these hours are essential.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Marketing & Business Development Assistant

RJR Maintenance & Management



Position: Marketing & Business Development Virtual Assistant  

Department: Marketing & Business Development  

Reports To: Director of Marketing & Business Development  

Work Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time  

Location: Remote



POSITION OVERVIEW



RJR Maintenance & Management is seeking a motivated, organized, creative, and detail-oriented Marketing & Business Development Assistant to support the company's marketing initiatives, business growth, and daily operations.



This individual will work directly with the Director of Marketing & Business Development, serving as an extension of the department by coordinating marketing campaigns, maintaining digital platforms, managing communications, tracking business opportunities, and assisting with various administrative responsibilities.



The ideal candidate is proactive, resourceful, comfortable with technology, and capable of managing multiple projects independently while maintaining excellent communication and attention to detail.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Marketing & Social Media



- Create, schedule, and publish social media content across
, Instagram, Google Business Profile, and other platforms.

- Design marketing materials, flyers, advertisements, and promotional graphics using Canva.

- Assist with developing and executing marketing campaigns for available rental properties, company services, and special events.

- Maintain a consistent brand image across all marketing channels.

- Monitor social media messages, comments, and engagement.

- Assist with creating short-form videos, reels, and other promotional content.

- Track marketing performance and prepare reports on engagement, reach, and campaign results.

- Research new marketing ideas, trends, and opportunities.



2. Property Marketing & Advertising



- Create, update, and maintain rental property advertisements across company websites and approved listing platforms.

- Ensure rental listings contain accurate descriptions, pricing, photographs, and property information.

- Coordinate with leasing staff to identify vacancies and marketing priorities.

- Monitor online listings for accuracy and consistency.

- Organize and maintain property photographs, marketing files, and promotional materials.

- Assist with developing marketing strategies to improve property exposure and generate qualified leads.

- Identify listings requiring updated photographs, descriptions, or additional advertising.



3. Business Development & Lead Management



- Research potential property management clients, investors, property owners, and business opportunities.

- Maintain an organized database of prospective clients and business contacts.

- Track incoming business development inquiries and ensure timely follow-up.

- Prepare introductory
s, follow-up communications, and marketing presentations.

- Assist with preparing property management proposals and informational materials.

- Schedule meetings, consultations, and appointments with prospective clients.

- Maintain a business development pipeline to track leads, conversations, proposals, and follow-up dates.

- Research local competitors, market trends, and opportunities for company growth.



4. Website & Digital Presence



- Assist with updating and maintaining the company's website.

- Ensure property listings, contact information, service descriptions, and company information remain accurate.

- Maintain and optimize Google Business Profile listings.

- Monitor online reviews and prepare responses for management approval when appropriate.

- Assist with search engine optimization (SEO), including website content, keywords, and local search visibility.

- Identify website errors, outdated information, and opportunities for improvement.

- Assist with
 marketing campaigns and company announcements.



5. Executive & Administrative Support



- Provide direct administrative assistance to the Director of Marketing & Business Development.

- Manage calendars, appointments, reminders, and project deadlines.

- Draft and organize
s, correspondence, presentations, and documents.

- Maintain organized digital files, spreadsheets, and marketing records.

- Track assigned projects and provide regular progress updates.

- Coordinate with internal departments to obtain information needed for marketing and business development.

- Assist with special projects, company events, and other assigned initiatives.

- Identify opportunities to improve workflows, organization, and efficiency.



6. Reporting & Accountability



- Maintain a daily task list and communicate progress on assigned responsibilities.

- Prepare weekly summaries of completed projects, marketing activities, and outstanding items.

- Track business development leads and follow-up activity.

- Monitor advertising performance and recommend improvements.

- Communicate obstacles, delays, or issues requiring management attention.

- Proactively identify tasks that can be completed without requiring constant direction.



QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS



- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organizational and time-management abilities.

- Experience with Canva, social media management, and digital marketing.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and spreadsheets.

- Ability to learn new software and technology quickly.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize deadlines.

- Professional communication and customer service skills.

- Previous experience in marketing, executive assistance, property management, or real estate is preferred but not required.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Success in this position will be measured by:



- Consistent and timely completion of assigned projects.

- Accurate, professional, and regularly updated marketing materials.

- Organized tracking of business development opportunities.

- Prompt follow-up and effective communication.

- Improved consistency of the company's online marketing presence.

- Strong initiative, reliability, and problem-solving abilities.

- The ability to reduce the Director's administrative workload and improve departmental efficiency.



POSITION EXPECTATIONS



The Marketing & Business Development Assistant is expected to represent RJR Maintenance & Management professionally in all communications and interactions.



The assistant will be trusted with company information, internal processes, marketing accounts, and business development records. Confidentiality, accountability, and adherence to company procedures are essential.



The position requires someone who is not simply waiting for instructions, but who actively looks for opportunities to help the department operate more effectively.



OUR GOAL



Build a highly organized and effective marketing and business development department that consistently attracts new clients, promotes available properties, strengthens the RJR brand, and supports the company's long-term growth.

title: Customer Support Specialist | US Tech Company (Full-Time, Long-Term People Only)
description:
Company: Moving Muscle, a fast-growing labor-only moving platform based in the United States. We are innovating the traditional moving industry by providing reliable, transparent moving labor to customers booking rental trucks and containers.



About the Role

We are hiring a Customer Support Specialist to handle inbound & outbound calls, SMS, live ticketing, job dispatch, and administrative data entry. You will be the front line ensuring our customers and movers get the right help at the right time. Having experience in local home service industry is vital for this role.



This role requires top-tier English, strong technical skills, professional phone presence, and proven customer support experience. We are only looking for serious professionals with a quiet workspace, excellent internet, and the right hardware to handle a demanding software stack.



Key Responsibilities

• Answer inbound calls with professionalism and empathy.

• Make outbound calls to customers and movers as needed for updates, confirmations, or issue resolution.

• Respond quickly to SMS and ticket inquiries (similar to Zendesk/Freshdesk).

• Dispatch movers to jobs in real-time, ensuring scheduling accuracy and customer satisfaction.

• Update and maintain internal systems (Slack for communication).

• Document issues clearly for management and escalate when necessary.

• Uphold high standards of accuracy, professionalism, and customer care.



**Required Skills & Experience (NON-NEGOTIABLE)**

• 3+ years in customer support / BPO / call center handling phone + ticket systems.

• Excellent spoken & written English. Neutral or near-neutral accent is required.

• Strong multitasking: handle calls, SMS, and tickets simultaneously.

• Experience with ticketing software (Front, Zendesk, or Freshdesk).

• Experience with VoIP calling systems (Aircall, RingCentral, Dialpad, etc.).

• Tech-savvy and comfortable with multiple SaaS platforms (Slack, Notion, Google Workspace).

• Quiet, professional home office setup: noise-canceling headset, reliable high-speed internet, backup plan for power/internet outages.

• Proven track record of reliability (we will check references and work history).



Work Environment & Equipment Requirements

• High-speed wired internet (minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload).

• Backup connection or contingency plan (must be explained in application).

• Fast, modern computer capable of running multiple SaaS apps simultaneously.

• Professional noise-canceling headset.

• Quiet, distraction-free workspace for clear calls.



Operating Hours:

8AM - 8PM Eastern Standard Time (US)



Please submit in your application if you are flexible on which shift hours or if there are strong preferences.



Compensation

$7.50 USD / hour ($225 per week, full-time, paid weekly)



Starting rate: $7.50/hr. We conduct performance reviews every quarter. Based on quality, consistency, and initiative, pay will increase over time based on contributions. We are seeking someone for the long-run who will be able to adjust roles over time and grow with us.



- Long-term role with growth potential for top performers.

- Training provided on company workflows; you are expected to already be very strong in core support skills and software.



Application Instructions:

To apply, you must follow these steps. Applications missing any step will not be considered.



1. Subject Line: Start your application header with the phrase:

“Strong Support Muscle” (this shows you pay attention to detail)



2. Loom Video (mandatory, under 5 minutes): Answer the following 3 questions in English. (No other formats accepted; Loom only.)

• Q1: Which industry do you have experience in as a customer support specialist role?

• Q2: What excites you the most about tech? What tools do you most use? 

• Q3: Quickly walk us through your home office setup (internet speed, backup plan, computer, headset, and workspace).



Why This Role:



This is NOT a “starter job.” This is a premium support role for someone who takes pride in delivering excellent service, can think independently, and wants to be part of a growing US startup revolutionizing the moving industry. If you are reliable, professional, and committed, you will be treated as a valued long-term partner.

title: SENIOR BOOKKEEPER
description:
Senior Executive Bookkeeper 



About Us

We’re a growing group of real estate companies based in Lee’s Summit, MO. Our businesses cover home buying, wholesaling, flips, new construction, and long term and short term rentals. We close 60 to 70 deals a year across multiple entities. We need a very experienced High Level bookkeeper to keep it all clean, current, and accurate. THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION. 



The Role

This is a contract position of about 10 hours per week, fully remote. You set your own schedule. We care about results: books that are reconciled, on time, and ready for our CPA.



What You’ll Handle



Maintain the books for multiple entities in QuickBooks Online

Categorize transactions and reconcile bank and credit card accounts monthly

Close each month by the 15th with a P&L and balance sheet for every entity

Track deal level income and costs on flips, wholesales, and builds

Track construction draws and job costs for new builds

Manage rental income and expenses by property

Record intercompany transactions between entities correctly

Run Profit First allocations

Process vendor bills and subcontractor payments

Collect W-9s and prepare 1099s at year end

Work with our CPA on tax prep and year end adjustments

Flag anything that looks off before it becomes a problem



What You Bring



5+ years of bookkeeping experience

Expert level QuickBooks Online skills

Experience managing books for multiple entities at once

Real estate, construction, or property management bookkeeping experience strongly preferred

Familiarity with Profit First is a plus

Comfortable with tools like Uncat, Keeper, Dext, or similar

Organized, detail driven, and able to work without supervision

Clear communicator who asks questions instead of guessing



We need an expert in this field. 



To Apply

Send your resume, the number of entities you currently manage, and the industries you’ve worked in.
